```groovy
      steps {
        sh '''
          syft ghcr.io/acme/api@${DIGEST} -o spdx-json > sbom.json
          cosign sign --yes ghcr.io/acme/api@${DIGEST}
          cosign attest --yes --type spdxjson --predicate sbom.json ghcr.io/acme/api@${DIGEST}
        '''
      }
    }
  }
}
```
Tekshirish: `cosign verify ghcr.io/acme/api@sha256:... --certificate-identity=... --certificate-oidc-issuer=...`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Image'ni tag bilan imzolash/deploy qilish — tag o'zgaradi; faqat digest.
- Release build'ni branch'dan qilish — tag/commit SHA'dan qil.
- Uzoq muddatli imzolash kalitini Jenkins credential'ida saqlash — KMS yoki keyless (OIDC).
- Plugin'larni pin qilmaslik — CI'ning o'zi supply chain'ning bir qismi.

**Senior nuqta:** Haqiqiy kafolat deploy tomonida tekshiruvda: imzo va provenance'ni admission policy majburlamasa, imzolash faqat "teatr". SLSA darajalarini maqsad sifatida qo'y (L2 -> L3: izolyatsiyalangan build).

33023.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `if:` step yoki job bajarilishi shartini belgilaydi. Status funksiyalari oldingi qadamlar holatiga qaraydi: `success()` — hammasi muvaffaqiyatli (default, `if` yozilmasa shu), `failure()` — oldingi biror qadam fail bo'lgan, `always()` — har qanday holatda (hatto bekor qilinganda), `cancelled()` — run bekor qilingan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
step1 ok -> step2 FAIL -> step3 (default success()) SKIP
                       -> step4 if: failure()       BAJARILADI
                       -> step5 if: always()        BAJARILADI
                       -> step6 if: !cancelled()    BAJARILADI (bekor qilinmagan)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
steps:
  - run: make test
  - name: Slack'ga xabar
    if: failure()
    run: ./notify-slack.sh
  - name: Loglarni saqlash
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
    with: {name: logs, path: logs/}
  - name: Release
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    run: ./release.sh
  - name: Faqat ma'lum step fail bo'lganda
    if: failure() && steps.migrate.outcome == 'failure'
    run: ./rollback-db.sh
```

**Ifoda qoidalari:**
- Status funksiyasi yozilmasa, GitHub avtomatik `success() &&` qo'shadi. Shuning uchun `if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` faqat oldingilar ok bo'lsa ishlaydi.
- `steps.<id>.outcome` — `continue-on-error` dan oldingi natija, `conclusion` — keyingi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `always()` foydalanuvchi run'ni bekor qilganda ham ishlaydi — uzoq cleanup bekor qilishni sekinlashtiradi; ko'pincha `!cancelled()` to'g'riroq.
- `if: ${{ secrets.X != '' }}` — secret'lar `if` da to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatilmaydi; avval `env` ga o'tkaz.
- `if:` da `${{ }}` ni `!` bilan boshlash — YAML'da `!` tag; `${{ !cancelled() }}` shaklida yoz.

**Senior nuqta:** Cleanup (test DB o'chirish, lock bo'shatish) uchun `!cancelled()` yoki `always()` ni aniq tanla va uni idempotent qil — u har qanday holatda ishga tushishi mumkin.

33024.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `env` — workflow/job/step darajasidagi muhit o'zgaruvchilari, YAML ichida yoziladi. `vars` — GitHub sozlamalarida saqlanadigan **maxfiy bo'lmagan** konfiguratsiya (region, URL), logda ochiq ko'rinadi. `secrets` — shifrlangan maxfiy qiymatlar (token, parol), logda yashiriladi.

**Taqqoslash:**

| | `env` | `vars` | `secrets` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qayerda | workflow faylida | Settings (repo/env/org) | Settings (shifrlangan) |
| Logda | ochiq | ochiq | `***` |
| Misol | `APP=billing` | `REGION=eu-central-1` | `DEPLOY_TOKEN` |
| Fork PR'da | bor | bor | yo'q |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
env:                       # workflow darajasi
  APP: billing
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment: production
    env:                   # job darajasi
      LOG_LEVEL: info
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh --app "$APP" --region "$REGION"
        env:               # step darajasi (eng ustun)
          REGION: ${{ vars.REGION }}
          TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TOKEN }}
```
```bash
gh variable set REGION --body eu-central-1 --env production
```

**Ustunlik (precedence):**
- `env`: step > job > workflow.
- `vars`/`secrets`: environment > repository > organization (bir xil nom bo'lsa).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Parolni `vars` ga qo'yish — logda ochiq va hamma o'qiy oladi.
- `${{ env.X }}` va `$X` farqi: birinchisi YAML parse vaqtida, ikkinchisi shell'da. `runs-on` yoki `if` da faqat `${{ }}` ishlaydi.
- Environment'ni ko'rsatmasdan environment `vars` ga murojaat — bo'sh qiymat.

**Senior nuqta:** Muhitlar farqini (stg/prod) `vars` va `secrets` ning environment darajasida saqla — workflow fayli bir xil qoladi, faqat `environment:` o'zgaradi.

33025.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Step'lar orasida qiymat runner taqdim etgan maxsus fayllar orqali uzatiladi: `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` ga `key=value` yozilsa, keyingi step'lar `${{ steps.<id>.outputs.key }}` bilan o'qiydi; `$GITHUB_ENV` ga yozilsa, keyingi barcha step'larda muhit o'zgaruvchisi bo'ladi. `$GITHUB_PATH` — PATH'ga katalog qo'shadi, `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` — run sahifasiga Markdown hisobot.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
steps:
  - id: ver
    run: echo "tag=$(git describe --tags --always)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  - run: echo "BUILD_ID=$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER-$GITHUB_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

  - run: echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

  - run: |
      echo "Tag: ${{ steps.ver.outputs.tag }}"
      echo "Build: $BUILD_ID"
      echo "## Natija" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      echo "- image: \`app:${{ steps.ver.outputs.tag }}\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
```

**Ko'p qatorli qiymat (delimiter):**
```bash
{
  echo "changelog<<EOF"
  git log --oneline -10
  echo "EOF"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
```

**Muhim:**
- `GITHUB_ENV` ga yozilgan qiymat shu step'da emas, **keyingi** step'lardan ko'rinadi.
- Step output faqat `id` bergan step uchun.
- Job'lar orasida — `jobs.<id>.outputs` orqali (alohida mexanizm).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Eski `::set-output` va `::set-env` buyruqlari deprecated (xavfsizlik sabab) — ishlatma.
- Untrusted qiymatni (PR title) `GITHUB_ENV` ga yozish — `NODE_OPTIONS` yoki `LD_PRELOAD` kabi o'zgaruvchi orqali kod ijrosi; delimiter injection xavfi.
- Secret'ni output'ga yozish — job output'lari mask qilinmasligi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Step output'larini aniq nomlangan, kichik qiymatlar uchun ishlat; katta ma'lumot (fayl, JSON hisobot) — workspace'da fayl yoki artifact.

33026.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `docker/login-action` bilan GHCR'ga `GITHUB_TOKEN` orqali kirish, `docker/setup-buildx-action` bilan BuildKit, `docker/build-push-action` bilan build va push. Workflow'ga `packages: write` ruxsati kerak. Tag sifatida commit SHA (va semver) ishlatiladi, `latest` emas; GHA cache bilan build tezlashadi.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
name: image
on:
  push: {branches: [main], tags: ['v*']}
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          tags: |
            type=sha
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          push: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
```

**Nega SHA tag:** `latest` qaysi kod ekanini bildirmaydi va o'zgarib turadi — rollback va audit qiyin. SHA/semver — deploy aniq versiyani biladi. Eng ishonchlisi — deploy'da digest (`@sha256:...`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- PR'da push qilish — fork PR'larda token read-only, xato beradi; PR'da faqat build.
- `permissions` ko'rsatilmasa va org default read-only bo'lsa — `denied: permission_denied`.
- `mode=max` cache katta — 10 GB repo cache limitini to'ldiradi va eski cache'lar o'chadi.
- Multi-arch build QEMU bilan sekin — `docker/setup-qemu-action` yoki native ARM runner.

**Senior nuqta:** Image'ga provenance va SBOM qo'sh (`provenance: true`, `sbom: true` yoki `actions/attest-build-provenance`) va cluster'da faqat imzolangan/attest qilingan image'larni qabul qil.

33027.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Job output'ini e'lon qilish uchun job darajasida `outputs:` yoziladi (odatda step output'iga havola), keyingi job `needs:` orqali bog'lanib `${{ needs.<job>.outputs.<name> }}` bilan o'qiydi. Kichik qiymatlar (tag, versiya, JSON ro'yxat) uchun; fayllar — artifact orqali.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
build job:
  step meta -> echo "image=..." >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  outputs.image = steps.meta.outputs.image
       |
       v  (needs: build)
deploy job:
  ${{ needs.build.outputs.image }}
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      image: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}
      digest: ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - id: meta
        run: echo "image=ghcr.io/org/app:${GITHUB_SHA}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - id: push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with: {push: true, tags: '${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}'}
  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          helm upgrade app ./chart \
            --set image.repository=ghcr.io/org/app \
            --set image.digest=${{ needs.build.outputs.digest }}
```

**Dinamik matrix uchun:** output'ga JSON yozib, `fromJSON()` bilan o'qish:
```yaml
matrix: {svc: '${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.services) }}'}
```

**Cheklovlar:**
- Output hajmi: har output 1 MB gacha, job bo'yicha jami ~50 MB.
- Output'lar Unicode string; JSON'ni `toJSON`/`fromJSON` bilan.
- Matrix job'ning output'i — oxirgi tugagan nusxaniki (deterministik emas).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `needs` ni yozmay `needs.build.outputs` ga murojaat — bo'sh qiymat.
- Secret'ni output'ga yozish — GitHub uni o'tkazmaydi (mask qilingan qiymat bo'sh keladi).
- Katta fayl mazmunini output'ga — limit; artifact ishlat.

**Senior nuqta:** Build va deploy orasida faqat o'zgarmas identifikator (image digest) uzat — deploy aynan test qilingan artifact'ni olishiga kafolat beradi.

33028.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Avval "changes" job'i qaysi servis papkalari o'zgarganini aniqlaydi (masalan `dorny/paths-filter`) va ro'yxatni JSON output qiladi; keyingi job `strategy.matrix` ni `fromJSON()` bilan shu ro'yxatdan quradi. Natija — faqat o'zgargan servislar build/test qilinadi. Bo'sh ro'yxatni `if:` bilan himoya qilish shart.

**Oqim:**
```
PR: services/billing/** va services/auth/** o'zgardi
changes job -> ["billing","auth"]
build job matrix -> build(billing), build(auth)   (payments yo'q)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      svcs: ${{ steps.f.outputs.changes }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: f
        with:
          filters: |
            billing:
              - 'services/billing/**'
              - 'pkg/**'
            auth:
              - 'services/auth/**'
              - 'pkg/**'
  build:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.svcs != '[]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        svc: ${{ fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.svcs) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make -C services/${{ matrix.svc }} test build
  ci-ok:                              # branch protection uchun yagona required check
    needs: [changes, build]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          [[ "${{ needs.build.result }}" =~ ^(success|skipped)$ ]] || exit 1
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Umumiy kod (`pkg/`, `go.mod`, CI fayllari) o'zgarganda hammasi build bo'lishi kerak — filter'ga qo'sh.
- Bo'sh matrix — "Matrix vector does not contain any values" xatosi; `if:` bilan.
- Required check sifatida `build (billing)` qo'yilsa — billing o'zgarmagan PR merge bo'lmaydi. Yagona "gate" job ishlat.
- Shallow clone'da diff hisoblanmaydi — `paths-filter` PR'da API ishlatadi, push'da `fetch-depth` kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Katta monorepo'da build tizimi (Bazel, Nx, Turborepo, Pants) bog'liqlik grafini aniqroq hisoblaydi; paths-filter — oddiy va yetarli boshlang'ich.

33029.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `workflow_run` — boshqa workflow tugaganda ishga tushadi (masalan CI muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgach deploy); u default branch kontekstida va secret'lar bilan ishlaydi. `workflow_dispatch` — qo'lda yoki API/CLI orqali input'lar bilan ishga tushirish (deploy, rollback). `repository_dispatch` — tashqi tizim (boshqa repo, webhook) API orqali custom event yuboradi.

**Qachon qaysi:**

| Event | Kim boshlaydi | Misol |
|---|---|---|
| `workflow_run` | boshqa workflow tugashi | CI -> deploy; fork PR natijasiga comment |
| `workflow_dispatch` | odam (UI, `gh`), API | "Deploy to prod" tugmasi, rollback |
| `repository_dispatch` | tashqi tizim API | boshqa repo'dagi release -> bu repo'da update |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# deploy.yml
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {ref: '${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}'}
```
```bash
gh workflow run deploy.yml -f env=prod -f version=v1.4.2
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.github.com/repos/org/app/dispatches \
  -d '{"event_type":"lib-released","client_payload":{"version":"2.1.0"}}'
```

**Xavfsizlik (`workflow_run`):** fork PR'dan kelgan CI'ning artifact'lari hujumchi nazoratida. `workflow_run` esa secret'lar va yozish huquqi bilan ishlaydi. Shuning uchun:
- artifact'ni faqat **ma'lumot** sifatida o'qi (masalan, test natijasi JSON), uni ishga tushirma;
- PR raqami, branch nomi kabi qiymatlarni shell'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'yma (injection).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `workflow_run` faqat default branch'dagi workflow faylidan ishlaydi — feature branch'da sinab bo'lmaydi.
- `head_sha` ni ko'rsatmasdan checkout — boshqa commit deploy bo'ladi.
- Zanjir chuqurligi 3 dan oshmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p hollarda `needs` bilan bitta workflow sodda va ishonchliroq; `workflow_run` ni ishonch chegarasini ajratish (untrusted CI -> trusted post-process) uchun ishlat.

33030.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Tag (`v1.2.3`) push qilinganda ishga tushadigan workflow: to'liq tarix bilan checkout, bir marta build (binary/image), release yaratish (changelog bilan), artifact'larni nashr qilish va keyin xuddi shu artifact'ni staging, so'ng approval bilan prod'ga deploy qilish. Tag yaratish huquqi ruleset bilan cheklanadi.

**Oqim:**
```
git tag v1.4.0 && git push --tags
   |
   v
release workflow:
  build (bir marta) -> image@sha256:abc + binary'lar + checksum
  GitHub Release + changelog
  attest provenance
   |
   v
deploy-stg (avtomatik) -> smoke test -> deploy-prod (environment approval)
   (ikkalasi ham aynan sha256:abc)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*.*.*']
permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write
  id-token: write
  attestations: write
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {fetch-depth: 0}        # changelog va git describe uchun
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: {go-version-file: go.mod}
      - uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6
        with: {args: release --clean}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
Release yaratish qo'lda: `gh release create v1.4.0 --generate-notes dist/*`.

**Muhim tamoyillar:**
- **Build once, deploy many:** staging va prod uchun qayta build yo'q — test qilingan artifact aynan prod'ga boradi.
- Versiya tag'dan olinadi (`${GITHUB_REF_NAME}`), qo'lda yozilmaydi.
- Tag ruleset: faqat release manager yoki bot `v*` tag yarata oladi, tag o'chirish/ko'chirish taqiqlangan.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `fetch-depth: 1` (default) — `git describe` va changelog ishlamaydi.
- Tag main'dan emas, tasodifiy branch'dan qo'yilgan — tekshirilmagan kod release bo'ladi; workflow'da tag commit main'da ekanini tekshir.
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` bilan yaratilgan release boshqa workflow'larni trigger qilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Release Please yoki semantic-release kabi vositalar conventional commit'lardan versiya va changelog'ni avtomatik chiqaradi — odam qo'lda tag qo'yish xatosini kamaytiradi.

33031.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `timeout-minutes` — job yoki step uchun maksimal vaqt (default 360 daqiqa — osilgan job 6 soat daqiqa yeydi). `continue-on-error` — step/job fail bo'lsa ham workflow muvaffaqiyatli hisoblanadi (eksperimental matrix kombinatsiyalari uchun). Retry — GitHub'da o'rnatilgan emas: action (`nick-fields/retry`) yoki shell loop bilan, faqat tarmoq/infra operatsiyalari uchun.

**Amalda:**
```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        go: ['1.23', '1.24']
        experimental: [false]
        include:
          - {go: 'tip', experimental: true}
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Dependency yuklash (tarmoq - retry mumkin)
        uses: nick-fields/retry@v3
        with:
          max_attempts: 3
          timeout_minutes: 5
          retry_wait_seconds: 10
          command: go mod download
      - name: Test
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: go test ./...
```
Shell'da oddiy retry:
```bash
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -fsS "$URL" -o file && break; sleep $((i*5)); done
```

**Qachon nima:**

| Vosita | Ishlat | Ishlatma |
|---|---|---|
| `timeout-minutes` | har job'da | — |
| `continue-on-error` | eksperimental versiya, ixtiyoriy skan | asosiy testlar |
| retry | `apt`, `go mod download`, registry push | unit/e2e testlar |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Testlarga retry — flaky testni yashiradi va haqiqiy race bug'ni prod'ga o'tkazadi.
- `continue-on-error: true` asosiy job'da — qizil bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan pipeline yashil ko'rinadi.
- `timeout-minutes` yo'q — osilgan integration test 6 soat runner yeydi.
- UI'da "Re-run failed jobs" ni odat qilish — flaky muammo hech qachon tuzatilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Job vaqtlarini kuzat va `timeout-minutes` ni p95 x 2 atrofida qo'y. Retry qilingan operatsiyalar sonini metrika sifatida yig' — u infra muammolarini oldindan ko'rsatadi.

33032.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Actions Runner Controller (ARC) — Kubernetes operator'i: GitHub'dagi navbatga qarab runner pod'larini avtomatik yaratadi va o'chiradi (runner scale set). Har job yangi, ephemeral pod'da ishlaydi va tugagach o'chadi — state va secret keyingi job'ga qolmaydi. Workflow'da `runs-on: <scale-set-nomi>`.

**Arxitektura:**
```
GitHub navbat (job kutmoqda)
     |
     v
ARC controller + listener (namespace arc-systems)
     | ephemeral runner pod yarat
     v
arc-runners namespace:  [runner pod job#1] [runner pod job#2]
     job tugadi -> pod o'chadi; minRunners..maxRunners oralig'ida autoscale
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
helm install arc --namespace arc-systems --create-namespace \
  oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set-controller
helm install arc-runner-set --namespace arc-runners --create-namespace \
  --set githubConfigUrl="https://github.com/acme" \
  --set githubConfigSecret=gh-app-secret \
  --set minRunners=0 --set maxRunners=50 \
  oci://ghcr.io/actions/actions-runner-controller-charts/gha-runner-scale-set
```
```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: arc-runner-set
```

**Production uchun qarorlar:**
- **Auth:** PAT emas, GitHub App.
- **Izolyatsiya:** runner group + repo allowlist; prod deploy uchun alohida scale set.
- **Cloud kirish:** node IAM roli emas — har job OIDC bilan; aks holda har job node rolini oladi.
- **Docker build:** `dind` (privileged — xavfli) o'rniga BuildKit rootless yoki Kaniko/Buildah; yoki alohida node pool.
- **Tezlik:** `minRunners: 0` arzon, lekin cold start (image pull 1-2 daqiqa) — image'ni kichik saqla, node'larda pre-pull, yoki ish vaqtida `minRunners: 2`.
- **Xarajat:** spot node pool, Karpenter.

**Monitoring:** queue time (job kutish), pod start time, runner xatolari; ARC listener metrikalari Prometheus'ga.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Public repo'ga ulash — fork PR'lar cluster ichida kod bajaradi.
- Privileged dind pod — container escape orqali node'ni egallash.
- Runner pod'lari prod workload bilan bitta cluster/node'da.

**Senior nuqta:** CI runner'lar — yuqori xavfli workload (ishonchsiz kod bajaradi). Ularni alohida cluster yoki kamida alohida node pool, network policy va egress cheklovi bilan izolyatsiya qil.

33033.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Merge queue "semantik konflikt" muammosini yechadi: ikki PR alohida yashil, lekin birga merge bo'lganda main buziladi. Queue har PR'ni main + oldingi navbatdagi PR'lar bilan birlashtirilgan vaqtinchalik branch'da tekshiradi va faqat yashil bo'lsa merge qiladi. CI'ni moslash uchun workflow `merge_group` event'ini qo'llab-quvvatlashi shart.

**Muammo:**
```
main: f(a)
PR A: f(a) -> f(a, b)   (imzo o'zgardi)       CI yashil
PR B: yangi joyda f(a) chaqiradi               CI yashil
merge A, keyin B -> main kompilyatsiya bo'lmaydi
```
"Require branches to be up to date" bilan yechish — har merge'dan keyin hamma PR rebase + CI qayta, katta jamoada navbat soatlab cho'ziladi.

**Queue qanday ishlaydi:**
```
queue: [A] [B] [C]
  gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-A      = main + A         -> CI
  gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-B      = main + A + B     -> CI (parallel)
  A yashil -> merge; B yashil -> merge
  B qizil -> B chiqariladi, C qayta (main + A + C)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:            # bu bo'lmasa required check hech qachon kelmaydi
jobs:
  unit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: [...]
  e2e:
    if: github.event_name == 'merge_group'    # og'ir testlar faqat queue'da
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: [...]
```
Ruleset: "Require merge queue" + required status checks (`unit`, `e2e`); build concurrency va grouping sozlamalari.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `merge_group` trigger yo'q — queue "Expected — waiting for status" holatida osilib qoladi.
- Required check faqat `merge_group` da ishlasa, PR'da ham u "kutilmoqda" bo'ladi — PR uchun skip qiluvchi yengil variant kerak.
- Flaky test butun navbatni qayta-qayta qayta qurdiradi — quarantine va flaky monitoring.
- `paths` filter bilan required check'lar — queue branch'ida mos kelmasligi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Queue CI vaqtini PR va merge bosqichlariga bo'lishga imkon beradi: tez check'lar PR'da (feedback), qimmat e2e faqat queue'da (kafolat). Navbat uzunligi va kutish vaqtini kuzat.

33034.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Artifact attestation — build natijasi (image, binary) uchun kriptografik imzolangan provenance: qaysi repo, qaysi commit, qaysi workflow, qaysi runner'da build qilingani. Actions'da `actions/attest-build-provenance` buni Sigstore orqali OIDC identifikatori bilan imzolaydi (SLSA provenance formatida). Deploy paytida `gh attestation verify` yoki cluster admission policy uni tekshiradi.

**Nega kerak:** Registry'ga kimdir (yoki buzilgan laptop) qo'lda `docker push ghcr.io/org/app:v1.4` qildi. Tag bir xil, lekin kod boshqa. Provenance bo'lmasa — buni bilib bo'lmaydi. Attestation bilan cluster "bu image bizning release workflow'imizda build qilinmagan" deb rad etadi.

**Oqim:**
```
build-push -> digest sha256:abc
attest     -> {subject: sha256:abc, repo, sha, workflow, runner}
              Sigstore (Fulcio cert OIDC identity bilan) imzo -> registry/GitHub
deploy     -> verify: imzo + workflow = org/app/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/v*
admission  -> Kyverno/Sigstore policy-controller: provenance yo'q -> rad
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
permissions:
  id-token: write
  attestations: write
  packages: write
  contents: read
steps:
  - id: push
    uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
    with: {push: true, tags: 'ghcr.io/org/app:${{ github.sha }}'}
  - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v2
    with:
      subject-name: ghcr.io/org/app
      subject-digest: ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}
      push-to-registry: true
```
Tekshirish:
```bash
gh attestation verify oci://ghcr.io/org/app@sha256:abc --owner org \
  --signer-workflow org/app/.github/workflows/release.yml
```
SBOM uchun: `actions/attest-sbom`.

**SLSA darajasi:** build'ni umumiy reusable workflow'da qilish — chaqiruvchi repo build logikasini o'zgartira olmaydi, bu SLSA Build Level 3 ga yaqinlashtiradi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Attestation yaratib, hech qayerda tekshirmaslik — foydasiz qog'oz.
- Tag bo'yicha verify — digest bo'yicha qil.
- Verify'da faqat `--owner` — org'dagi har qanday workflow (hatto test repo) mos keladi; `--signer-workflow` bilan chekla.

**Senior nuqta:** Supply chain zanjiri: pin qilingan action'lar -> izolyatsiyalangan build -> attestation -> admission policy. Bitta halqa yo'q bo'lsa, qolganlari kafolat bermaydi.

33035.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Flaky test bilan ishlash tartibi: aniqlash (bir commit'da goh o'tadi, goh yiqiladi), cheklash (quarantine — pipeline'ni bloklamaydi, lekin egasi va muddati bor), ildiz sababini topish va tuzatish, takrorlanmasligini oldini olish (hermetic testlar). Retry bilan yashirish — yechim emas.

**Nega muhim:** Flaky testlar ishonchni yo'qotadi: jamoa qizil CI'ni "yana flaky" deb e'tiborsiz qoldiradi, haqiqiy bug ham o'tib ketadi. Re-run'lar daqiqa va vaqt yeydi.

**Jarayon:**
```
1. Detect   -> JUnit XML + test analytics: bir SHA'da pass va fail
2. Contain  -> quarantine ro'yxati (skip yoki non-blocking), ticket + owner + muddat
3. Reproduce-> ko'p marta, shuffle va race bilan
4. Fix      -> ildiz sababi
5. Prevent  -> hermetic test, fake clock, lint
```

**Amalda (Go):**
```bash
go test -run TestOrderFlow -count=200 -race -shuffle=on ./orders/...
go test -count=1 -p 1 ./...      # parallellik muammosini ajratish
```
Quarantine:
```go
func TestPaymentWebhook(t *testing.T) {
    if os.Getenv("RUN_QUARANTINED") == "" {
        t.Skip("flaky: OPS-412, @dilshod, 2026-10-20 gacha")
    }
}
```
Tungi workflow quarantine testlarini alohida ishlatib, statistika yig'adi.

**Odatiy ildiz sabablari:**

| Sabab | Tuzatish |
|---|---|
| `time.Sleep`, `time.Now()` | fake clock, `Eventually` polling |
| test tartibiga bog'liqlik, global state | `t.Cleanup`, izolyatsiya |
| port to'qnashuvi | `:0` port, `httptest` |
| tashqi servis/internet | testcontainers, mock server |
| data race | `-race`, sinxronizatsiya |
| map iteratsiya tartibi | sort qilib solishtirish |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Avtomatik retry — flaky "yashil" bo'ladi, real race bug prod'ga chiqadi.
- Quarantine muddatsiz — "qabriston"ga aylanadi, testlar hech qachon qaytmaydi.
- Flaky'ni testni o'chirib "tuzatish" — qamrov yo'qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Flaky rate'ni jamoa metrikasi qil (masalan, < 1% run). Ko'p flaky testlar ko'pincha prod kodidagi haqiqiy concurrency muammosining belgisi.

33036.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Keraksiz run'larni kesish (`paths`, `concurrency: cancel-in-progress`), qolganlarini tezlashtirish (cache, parallel/sharding, critical path'ni qisqartirish), qimmat resurslarni cheklash (macOS, larger runner'lar), osilgan job'larni to'xtatish (`timeout-minutes`) va storage'ni tozalash (artifact retention).

**Qayerdan pul va vaqt ketadi:**
```
docs o'zgarishi ham to'liq CI      -> paths-ignore
har push eski run'ni davom ettiradi -> cancel-in-progress
har job dependency'ni noldan yuklaydi -> cache
bitta 25 daqiqalik test job        -> 4 ta shard parallel
macOS'da Linux qila oladigan ish   -> Linux
osilgan job 6 soat                 -> timeout-minutes
90 kunlik artifact'lar             -> retention-days: 7
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
on:
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore: ['docs/**', '**.md']
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      matrix: {shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: {go-version-file: go.mod, cache: true}
      - run: go test $(go list ./... | awk "NR % 4 == ${{ matrix.shard }} - 1")
```
Docker: `cache-from/to: type=gha`, multi-stage, kichik context (`.dockerignore`).

**O'lchash:**
- Billing -> Actions usage (repo/workflow bo'yicha daqiqa).
- Har job vaqti (`gh run view --json jobs`), queue time.
- Eng sekin 10 job — birinchi optimizatsiya nomzodlari.

**Narx tafovuti:** macOS daqiqasi Linux'dan ~10x, Windows ~2x qimmat; larger runner'lar yadro soniga proporsional.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cache'ni katta qilib qo'yish — restore noldan build'dan sekin.
- Haddan ortiq sharding — har shard setup (checkout, cache) xarajati qo'shiladi.
- Self-hosted "bepul" deb hisoblash — ops, xavfsizlik va idle node narxi bor.

**Senior nuqta:** Optimizatsiyaning maqsadi — dasturchining feedback vaqti (PR'dan natijagacha p50/p95), daqiqa emas. Ikkalasini birga kuzat.

33037.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Markazlashtirilgan, versiyalangan reusable workflow'lar (masalan `org/platform-workflows` repo'da `go-ci.yml@v3`), Rulesets orqali majburiy check'lar va required workflow'lar (security scan), aniq versiyalash va deprecation siyosati, qaysi repo qaysi versiyada ekanini ko'rsatuvchi inventar va ochiq exception jarayoni. Prinsip — golden path: to'g'ri yo'l eng oson yo'l.

**Tuzilma:**
```
org/platform-workflows  (CODEOWNERS: platform jamoa)
  .github/workflows/
    go-ci.yml        v3.x   (lint, test, build, scan)
    docker-build.yml v2.x
    deploy-k8s.yml   v4.x
org/.github
  workflow-templates/    -> "New workflow" UI'da tayyor shablonlar

repo-A: uses: org/platform-workflows/.github/workflows/go-ci.yml@v3
repo-B: uses: ...@v2   (deprecated, 2026-12 gacha)
```

**Majburlash (Rulesets, org darajasida):**
- Required status checks (`ci / test`).
- Required workflows: har repo'da security scan, repo o'chira olmaydi.
- Branch protection: review, signed commit, force push taqiqi.
- Actions policy: allowlist action'lar, SHA pin.

**Versiyalash:**
- Semver tag'lar; major versiyada breaking change.
- Eski major uchun deprecation e'loni va muddat (masalan, 3 oy).
- Renovate/Dependabot reusable workflow versiyalarini ham yangilaydi.

**Inventar:**
```bash
gh search code "platform-workflows/.github/workflows/go-ci.yml@" --owner acme \
  --json repository,textMatches
```
Natijani dashboard (yoki Backstage scorecard) da ko'rsat: qaysi repo eski versiyada.

**Exception jarayoni:** repo qo'shimcha workflow qo'sha oladi, lekin required check'larni o'chira olmaydi; haqiqiy istisno — ticket, egasi, muddat bilan.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `@main` ga murojaat — bitta xato hamma repo'ni bir vaqtda buzadi.
- Hamma narsani majburlash — jamoalar chetlab o'tadi yoki platformaga qarshi chiqadi.
- Shablonni nusxalash (copy-paste) — 200 repo'da 200 xil drift.

**Senior nuqta:** Platforma o'zgarishini canary qil: yangi versiyani avval bir nechta pilot repo'da, keyin keng. CI standarti ham mahsulot — foydalanuvchilar (jamoalar) fikri va adoption metrikasi bilan boshqariladi.

33038.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `before_script` — asosiy skriptdan oldin bajariladi (tayyorgarlik: dependency yuklash, login); `script` — job'ning asosiy ishi (majburiy); `after_script` — job natijasidan qat'i nazar (muvaffaqiyat yoki xato) oxirida bajariladi (tozalash). `before_script` va `script` bitta shell'da birlashtirib ishlaydi; `after_script` — alohida yangi shell'da.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
[before_script + script]  (bitta shell sessiyasi)
     |  biror buyruq fail -> qolganlari bajarilmaydi, job FAILED
     v
[after_script]            (YANGI shell, alohida timeout ~5 daqiqa)
     |  fail bo'lsa ham job natijasini o'zgartirmaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
default:
  before_script:
    - go mod download

integration:
  image: golang:1.23
  before_script:                        # default'ni ustidan yozadi
    - export TEST_DB=test_$CI_JOB_ID
    - ./scripts/create-db.sh "$TEST_DB"
  script:
    - go test -tags=integration ./...
  after_script:
    - ./scripts/drop-db.sh "test_$CI_JOB_ID"   # $TEST_DB bu yerda YO'Q
    - echo "Job holati: $CI_JOB_STATUS"        # success / failed / canceled
```

**Muhim nuanslar:**
- `after_script` `before_script`/`script` da `export` qilingan o'zgaruvchilarni ko'rmaydi — qayta hisobla yoki faylga yoz.
- `after_script` timeout'i alohida (default 5 daqiqa; `RUNNER_AFTER_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT`).
- `$CI_JOB_STATUS` faqat `after_script` da — natijaga qarab harakat qilish uchun.
- Job darajasidagi `before_script` `default:` dagini almashtiradi (birlashtirmaydi).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Cleanup'ni `script` oxiriga qo'yish — test fail bo'lsa cleanup bajarilmaydi.
- `after_script` dagi xato pipeline'ni qizil qilmaydi — muhim tekshiruvni u yerga qo'yma.
- Job bekor qilinganda (cancel) `after_script` yangi versiyalarda bajariladi, eski versiyalarda yo'q — unga to'liq tayanma.

**Senior nuqta:** Cleanup'ni idempotent va resurs nomini deterministik (`$CI_JOB_ID` bilan) qil — `after_script` bajarilmagan holatlar uchun TTL asosidagi "garbage collector" job'i ham bo'lsin.

33039.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `allow_failure` — job fail bo'lsa ham pipeline davom etadi va sariq ogohlantirish bilan "passed" bo'ladi (`exit_codes` bilan faqat ma'lum kodlar uchun). `retry` — job fail bo'lganda avtomatik qayta urinish (max 2), `when` bilan faqat ma'lum xato turlarida. `timeout` — job uchun maksimal vaqt (loyiha default'i, ko'pincha 1 soat).

**Amalda:**
```yaml
lint:
  script: golangci-lint run
  allow_failure: true                # ogohlantirish, bloklamaydi

security-scan:
  script: ./scan.sh
  allow_failure:
    exit_codes: [2]                  # 2 = "past severity topildi" - ok; boshqa kod - fail

e2e:
  timeout: 30m
  retry:
    max: 2
    when:
      - runner_system_failure
      - stuck_or_timeout_failure
      - scheduler_failure
  script: make e2e
```
Ko'p uchraydigan `retry.when` qiymatlari: `runner_system_failure`, `stuck_or_timeout_failure`, `api_failure`, `scheduler_failure`, `data_integrity_failure`, `script_failure` (bunisi xavfli).
Yangi versiyalarda: `retry: exit_codes: [137]` (OOM yoki spot o'ldirilishi).

**Qachon nima:**

| Kalit | Ishlat | Ishlatma |
|---|---|---|
| `allow_failure` | eksperimental, ixtiyoriy skan | asosiy testlar, build |
| `retry` + `when` infra | spot runner, tarmoq | test xatosi uchun |
| `timeout` | har job'ga real qiymat | — |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `retry: 2` (`when` siz) — test fail'ini ham qayta urinadi; flaky test yashirinadi.
- `allow_failure: true` muhim job'da — qizil bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan pipeline yashil ko'rinadi, hech kim qaramaydi.
- `timeout` runner'ning o'z timeout'idan katta — kichigi amal qiladi.
- `allow_failure` li `when: manual` job — pipeline'ni bloklamaydi (manual job default `allow_failure: true`).

**Senior nuqta:** `allow_failure` li job'larni vaqtinchalik deb hisobla — egasi va muddat bilan. Retry statistikasini kuzat: ko'p retry — runner yoki infra muammosi signali.

33040.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab pipeline'lari turli manbalardan yaratiladi: branch push (`push`), tag (`push` + `CI_COMMIT_TAG`), merge request (`merge_request_event`), jadval (`schedule`), qo'lda (`web`), API/trigger (`api`, `trigger`), boshqa pipeline'dan (`parent_pipeline`, `pipeline`). `CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE` qaysi manba ekanini aytadi va `rules` orqali har tur uchun turli job'larni tanlash va dublikat pipeline'larning oldini olishga yordam beradi.

**Muammo (dublikat):** Branch'ga push qilding, MR ham ochiq — GitLab ikkita pipeline yaratadi: branch pipeline va MR pipeline. Runner ikki barobar ishlaydi.

**Yechim (workflow:rules):**
```yaml
workflow:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"   # MR -> MR pipeline
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH && $CI_OPEN_MERGE_REQUESTS
      when: never                                         # MR ochiq branch push -> yo'q
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH                               # oddiy branch push
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG                                  # tag
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"
```
Qisqa variant — tayyor shablon: `include: template: Workflows/MergeRequest-Pipelines.gitlab-ci.yml` (yoki `Branch-Pipelines`).

**Job darajasida manba bo'yicha:**
```yaml
unit:
  script: go test ./...          # hamma pipeline'da

nightly-e2e:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"
  script: make e2e

release:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/
  script: ./release.sh
```

**Manbalar jadvali:**

| `CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE` | Qachon |
|---|---|
| `push` | branch yoki tag push |
| `merge_request_event` | MR yaratildi/yangilandi |
| `schedule` | jadval |
| `web` | UI'dan "Run pipeline" |
| `api` / `trigger` | API, trigger token |
| `parent_pipeline` | child pipeline |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- MR pipeline'da `CI_COMMIT_BRANCH` bo'sh — `CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_NAME` ishlat.
- `workflow:rules` hech biriga mos kelmasa — pipeline umuman yaratilmaydi.
- Protected variable'lar MR pipeline'ida (protected bo'lmagan source branch) — mavjud emas.

**Senior nuqta:** `workflow:rules` ni har loyihada standart shablon bilan ber — dublikat pipeline'lar runner xarajatini sezilarli oshiradi va jamoani chalg'itadi.

33041.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab har loyiha uchun o'rnatilgan Container Registry beradi va job'ga avtomatik credential'lar (`CI_REGISTRY`, `CI_REGISTRY_USER`, `CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD`, `CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE`) beradi. Job registry'ga login qilib, image'ni commit SHA tag bilan build va push qiladi. Docker-in-Docker (DinD) privileged runner talab qiladi — xavfsizroq alternativa: Kaniko yoki Buildah.

**DinD bilan:**
```yaml
build-image:
  image: docker:27
  services: [docker:27-dind]
  variables:
    DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: "/certs"
  script:
    - echo "$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD" | docker login -u "$CI_REGISTRY_USER" --password-stdin "$CI_REGISTRY"
    - docker build --pull -t "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA" .
    - docker push "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA"
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
```

**Privileged'siz (Buildah):**
```yaml
build-image:
  image: quay.io/buildah/stable
  script:
    - buildah login -u "$CI_REGISTRY_USER" -p "$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD" "$CI_REGISTRY"
    - buildah build -t "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA" .
    - buildah push "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA"
```
Kaniko ham keng ishlatilgan, lekin asl Google loyihasi 2025 da arxivlandi — fork'lar yoki Buildah/BuildKit rootless'ga o'tish tavsiya.

**Tag strategiyasi:**
- `$CI_COMMIT_SHA` — har build noyob, deploy aniq versiyani biladi.
- `$CI_COMMIT_TAG` (v1.4.0) — release.
- `latest` — faqat qulaylik uchun, deploy'da ishlatma.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `docker login -p $PASS` — parol process ro'yxatida va ba'zan logda; `--password-stdin` ishlat.
- DinD uchun runner `privileged = true` — job host'ni egallashi mumkin; shared runner'larda xavfli.
- Layer cache yo'q — har build noldan; `--cache-from` yoki registry cache.
- Registry cleanup policy yo'q — storage cheksiz o'sadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Image'ni imzola (cosign) va SBOM qo'sh; deploy'da tag emas, digest ishlat. Registry'da cleanup policy (masalan, 30 kundan eski SHA tag'larni o'chirish, release tag'larni saqlash) sozla.

33042.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `parallel: N` — bitta job'ning N ta bir xil nusxasini parallel ishga tushiradi; har biri `CI_NODE_INDEX` (1..N) va `CI_NODE_TOTAL` oladi — test sharding uchun. `parallel: matrix` — o'zgaruvchilar kombinatsiyalari bo'yicha job nusxalarini yaratadi (masalan REGION x ENV), har nusxa o'z o'zgaruvchilari bilan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
parallel: 4
  test 1/4  test 2/4  test 3/4  test 4/4    (CI_NODE_INDEX=1..4)

parallel: matrix [REGION: eu, us] x [ENV: stg, prod]
  deploy: [eu, stg]  [eu, prod]  [us, stg]  [us, prod]
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
test:
  image: golang:1.23
  parallel: 4
  script:
    - go list ./... | awk "NR % $CI_NODE_TOTAL == $CI_NODE_INDEX - 1" > pkgs.txt
    - go test $(cat pkgs.txt)

build:
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - ARCH: [amd64, arm64]
  script: GOARCH=$ARCH go build -o app-$ARCH ./cmd/app
  artifacts: {paths: ["app-$ARCH"]}

deploy:
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - REGION: [eu, us]
        ENV: [stg, prod]
  script: ./deploy.sh "$ENV" "$REGION"
  environment: $ENV-$REGION
```
Matrix job'ning aniq nusxasiga bog'lanish:
```yaml
package-amd64:
  needs:
    - job: build
      parallel:
        matrix:
          - ARCH: amd64
  script: ./package.sh app-amd64
```

**Cheklovlar:** bitta job uchun 200 tagacha nusxa; job nomlari `deploy: [eu, stg]` shaklida.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Sharding fayl soni bo'yicha — bir shard'ga og'ir testlar tushib, u boshqalardan 3x uzoq; test vaqti bo'yicha taqsimla (JUnit tarixidan).
- Har nusxa setup (image pull, cache restore) qiladi — juda ko'p mayda shard foydasiz.
- Matrix'dagi prod deploy'lar parallel — bir vaqtda hamma region'ga chiqish xavfli; `resource_group` yoki bosqichma-bosqich.

**Senior nuqta:** Shard soni = (umumiy test vaqti / maqsad vaqt), lekin runner sig'imi bilan chekla. Matrix'ni deploy uchun ishlatganda region'lar orasida canary tartibini saqla.

33043.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `resource_group` — bir xil guruhdagi job'lar bir vaqtda faqat bittadan ishlashini ta'minlaydi (mutex): ikki pipeline bir vaqtda production'ga deploy qilmaydi. `interruptible: true` — shu branch'ga yangi pipeline kelganda, eski pipeline'dagi bu job avtomatik bekor qilinishi mumkinligini bildiradi ("Auto-cancel redundant pipelines" bilan) — runner tejaladi.

**Muammo (resource_group'siz):**
```
Pipeline #100 (v1.5) deploy-prod boshlandi ... sekin
Pipeline #101 (v1.6) deploy-prod boshlandi ... tez tugadi
#100 tugadi -> prod'da ESKI v1.5 qoldi (yangisini bosib ketdi)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
test:
  interruptible: true          # yangi commit kelsa eski test'ni bekor qilsa bo'ladi
  script: go test ./...

build:
  interruptible: true
  script: make build

deploy-prod:
  interruptible: false         # yarim deploy bekor qilinmasin
  resource_group: production   # bir vaqtda faqat bitta
  environment: production
  script: ./deploy.sh
```
Navbat tartibi (API orqali sozlanadi):
```bash
curl --request PUT --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $T" \
  "https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4/projects/42/resource_groups/production?process_mode=newest_first"
```

| `process_mode` | Xatti-harakat |
|---|---|
| `unordered` (default) | birinchi bo'shagan oladi |
| `oldest_first` | yaratilish tartibida |
| `newest_first` | eng yangisi; eskilari skip — deploy uchun ko'pincha eng mantiqli |
| `newest_ready_first` | eng yangi tayyori |

**Auto-cancel qoidasi:** pipeline faqat hamma ishlayotgan job'lari `interruptible: true` bo'lsa (yoki hali boshlanmagan) bekor qilinadi. Bitta `interruptible: false` job ishga tushgan bo'lsa — pipeline bekor qilinmaydi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Deploy job'ini `interruptible: true` qilish — yangi push yarim deploy'ni uzadi.
- `resource_group` nomini dinamik qilmaslik (masalan `review` hamma MR uchun) — hamma review deploy'lar bir-birini kutadi; `review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG` ishlat.
- `oldest_first` bilan sekin navbat — eski versiyalar ketma-ket deploy qilinadi.

**Senior nuqta:** `resource_group` — CI darajasidagi lock; uni Terraform state lock yoki Argo sync bilan birga ishlat — har qatlam o'z poygasidan himoya qiladi.

33044.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Default'da job oldingi stage'lardagi **barcha** job'larning artifact'larini yuklab oladi. `dependencies` (stage modelida) — qaysi job'lardan artifact olishni cheklaydi (`[]` — hech qaysidan). `needs` bilan esa artifact'lar faqat `needs` dagi job'lardan olinadi, `artifacts: false` bilan alohida o'chiriladi. Maqsad — keraksiz yuklashni kamaytirib, pipeline'ni tezlashtirish.

**Muammo:**
```
build-frontend -> 500 MB node_modules artifact
build-backend  -> 50 MB binary
lint (test stage) -> ikkalasini yuklaydi (550 MB) - keraksiz!
deploy-backend    -> 500 MB frontend ham yuklanadi
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
lint:
  stage: test
  dependencies: []              # artifact kerak emas
  script: make lint

unit-backend:
  stage: test
  dependencies: [build-backend] # faqat backend
  script: ./run-tests.sh

deploy-backend:
  stage: deploy
  needs:
    - job: build-backend
      artifacts: true           # binary kerak
    - job: unit-backend
      artifacts: false          # faqat tugashini kutish
  script: ./deploy.sh dist/app
```
Artifact o'zi uchun:
```yaml
build-backend:
  script: go build -o dist/app ./cmd/app
  artifacts:
    paths: [dist/app]
    expire_in: 3 days           # saqlash muddati
    when: on_success
```

**`dependencies` va `needs`:**

| | `dependencies` | `needs` |
|---|---|---|
| Bajarilish tartibi | o'zgarmaydi (stage) | DAG, erta boshlanadi |
| Artifact | ro'yxatdagilardan | needs'dagilardan (`artifacts: false` bilan o'chirish) |
| Birga | `needs` bo'lsa `dependencies` ham uning ichidan bo'lishi kerak |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `dependencies` dagi job artifact'i muddati o'tgan — job "artifacts expired" bilan fail.
- `needs: []` bilan artifact kerak bo'lgan job — hech narsa olmaydi.
- `expire_in` yo'q — artifact'lar instance default'igacha saqlanib storage to'ladi.
- Test hisobotlari (`reports: junit`) va oddiy artifact'larni aralashtirish — hisobotlar ham har job'ga yuklanadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Artifact oqimini pipeline grafidek loyihala: har artifact'ning bitta yaratuvchisi va aniq iste'molchilari bo'lsin. Katta artifact'lar uchun registry (image, package) yaxshiroq tashuvchi.

33045.a:
**Qisqa javob:** YAML anchor (`&` / `*` / `<<: *`) — standart YAML xususiyati, faqat bitta fayl ichida ishlaydi va massivlarni birlashtirmaydi. `extends` — GitLab'ning job darajasidagi meros mexanizmi, `include` qilingan fayllar orasida ham ishlaydi (hash'larni chuqur birlashtiradi, massivlarni almashtiradi). `!reference [job, key]` — GitLab'ning maxsus tag'i: boshqa job'ning aniq bir bo'lagini (masalan `script` yoki `rules`) joylashtiradi, fayllar orasida ham ishlaydi va massiv ichiga qo'shish imkonini beradi.

**Taqqoslash:**

| | YAML anchor | `extends` | `!reference` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fayllar orasida | yo'q | ha | ha |
| Daraja | ixtiyoriy tugun | butun job | aniq kalit |
| Massiv | almashtiradi | almashtiradi | ichiga qo'shish mumkin |
| Ichma-ich | — | ha | 10 darajagacha |

**Amalda:**
```yaml
.setup:
  script:
    - go mod download
    - go install gotest.tools/gotestsum@latest

.mr-rules:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"

test:
  script:
    - !reference [.setup, script]     # 2 ta buyruq shu yerga
    - gotestsum ./...
  rules:
    - !reference [.mr-rules, rules]
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
```
YAML anchor (faqat shu faylda):
```yaml
.defaults: &defaults
  image: golang:1.23
  tags: [docker]

lint:
  <<: *defaults
  script: make lint
```
`extends` bilan nima bo'lardi:
```yaml
test:
  extends: .setup
  script: [gotestsum ./...]   # .setup script'i ALMASHTIRILADI, qo'shilmaydi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Anchor'ni `include` qilingan fayldagi tugunga ishlatish — ishlamaydi.
- `extends` bilan `script` "qo'shilmoqchi" bo'lish — oldingi buyruqlar yo'qoladi.
- `!reference` dagi kalit yo'q — pipeline yaratilmaydi (lint xatosi).

**Senior nuqta:** Odatiy qoida: butun job shabloni uchun `extends`, umumiy `script`/`rules` bo'laklari uchun `!reference`, anchor'lardan qochish (GitLab'ga xos imkoniyatlar aniqroq va fayllararo ishlaydi).

33046.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Scheduled pipeline — loyiha sozlamalarida cron bilan berilgan jadval bo'yicha avtomatik pipeline (`CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"`); har jadvalga o'z o'zgaruvchilari beriladi. Pipeline trigger token — tashqi tizim API orqali pipeline ishga tushirishi uchun maxsus token (`CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "trigger"`), o'zgaruvchilar bilan.

**Schedule:**
- UI: Build -> Pipeline schedules -> `0 2 * * *`, timezone, branch `main`, o'zgaruvchi `SUITE=e2e`.
- Yoki API/Terraform (`gitlab_pipeline_schedule` resursi) — kod sifatida.
```yaml
nightly-e2e:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule" && $SUITE == "e2e"
  script: make e2e

dependency-scan-weekly:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule" && $SUITE == "deps"
  script: ./scan-deps.sh

unit:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE != "schedule"   # jadvalda oddiy testlar ishlamasin
  script: go test ./...
```

**Trigger token:**
```bash
curl --request POST \
  --form token="$TRIGGER_TOKEN" \
  --form ref=main \
  --form "variables[ENV]=stg" \
  "https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4/projects/42/trigger/pipeline"
```
Boshqa GitLab pipeline'idan esa token o'rniga `trigger: project:` yoki `CI_JOB_TOKEN` ishlatish yaxshiroq.

**Muhim nuans — egalik:** Schedule pipeline'i jadval egasi (owner) foydalanuvchi nomidan va uning huquqlari bilan ishlaydi; trigger token ham uni yaratgan foydalanuvchiga bog'liq. U kompaniyadan ketsa yoki bloklansa — schedule/trigger to'xtaydi (va deaktivatsiya qilingan holda ham xavf).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Schedule egasi — odam; ketganda tungi e2e'lar jimgina to'xtaydi. Service account yoki bot foydalanuvchiga o'tkaz va egasini muntazam tekshir.
- Trigger token'ni skriptlarda ochiq saqlash — u bilan pipeline (va protected branch'da protected secret'lar) ishga tushiriladi; secret sifatida saqla va rotatsiya qil.
- `workflow:rules` schedule'ni hisobga olmasa — pipeline umuman yaratilmaydi.
- Bir vaqtga ko'p schedule (hamma 00:00 da) — runner navbati tirbandligi; vaqtlarni tarqat.

**Senior nuqta:** Jadvallarni IaC'da (Terraform GitLab provider) boshqar — kim, qaysi branch, qaysi o'zgaruvchilar bilan — UI'da yashirin qolmasin va review'dan o'tsin.

33047.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Autoscaling — runner manager navbatga qarab job'lar uchun resursni dinamik yaratadi: kubernetes executor (har job pod, cluster autoscaler/Karpenter node qo'shadi) yoki docker-autoscaler/instance executor (fleeting plaginlari bilan cloud VM'lar; eski docker+machine deprecated). Distributed cache — runner'lar umumiy object storage'da (S3/GCS/Azure) cache saqlaydi, shunda qaysi runner job olsa ham cache topadi.

**Arxitektura:**
```
GitLab navbat
   ^ poll
runner manager (concurrent=200)
   | job
   v
kubernetes executor -> pod (cpu/memory request/limit)
   node yetmasa -> Karpenter yangi node (spot)
cache:  pod <--> S3 bucket "ci-cache" (umumiy)
```

**Amalda (`config.toml`):**
```toml
concurrent = 200            # manager bo'yicha jami parallel job
check_interval = 3

[[runners]]
  name = "k8s-build"
  executor = "kubernetes"
  limit = 150               # shu runner uchun
  [runners.cache]
    Type = "s3"
    Shared = true           # boshqa runner'lar bilan bo'lishadi
    [runners.cache.s3]
      ServerAddress = "s3.amazonaws.com"
      BucketName = "ci-cache"
      BucketLocation = "eu-central-1"
      # credential - IRSA/Pod Identity orqali, kalitsiz
  [runners.kubernetes]
    namespace = "ci-jobs"
    cpu_request = "1"
    cpu_limit = "4"
    memory_request = "2Gi"
    memory_limit = "4Gi"
    poll_timeout = 600
    [runners.kubernetes.node_selector]
      "workload" = "ci"
```
Job darajasida resursni oshirish (ruxsat berilgan bo'lsa): `KUBERNETES_MEMORY_LIMIT: 8Gi`.

**Monitoring:**
```promql
gitlab_runner_jobs{state="running"}
gitlab_runner_concurrent
histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(gitlab_runner_job_queue_duration_seconds_bucket[10m]))
```
Asosiy SLI — job queue duration (job qancha kutdi).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Request/limit yo'q — bitta og'ir job node'ni egallaydi, boshqalari OOM/CPU throttling.
- Spot node'lar o'ldiriladi — `retry: when: [runner_system_failure]`, uzoq job'lar on-demand pool'da.
- S3 cache'da lifecycle yo'q — bucket cheksiz o'sadi; 14-30 kunlik expiration.
- `concurrent` kichik — runner'lar bo'sh, job'lar navbatda.

**Senior nuqta:** Scale-to-zero arzon, lekin cold start (node + image pull) daqiqalar oladi — ish vaqtida minimal "issiq" sig'im va prebuilt, kichik CI image'lar bilan muvozanat qil.

33048.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab tayyor shablonlarni `include: template:` bilan ulaydi: SAST (kod statik tahlili), Secret Detection (kodda kalitlar), Dependency Scanning (zaif kutubxonalar), Container Scanning (image CVE'lari), DAST (ishlayotgan ilovaga hujum simulyatsiyasi). Natijalar MR'da va Security Dashboard'da ko'rinadi. Ultimate'da scan'ni policy (scan execution / pipeline execution policy) darajasida majburlash mumkin, shunda jamoa uni `.gitlab-ci.yml` dan olib tashlay olmaydi.

**Qayerda nima topadi:**
```
kod yozildi  -> SAST (SQL injection, unsafe deserialization)
             -> Secret Detection (AWS key, token)
dependency   -> Dependency Scanning (CVE'li kutubxona)
image        -> Container Scanning (OS paketlari CVE)
deploy (stg) -> DAST (XSS, header'lar, real HTTP)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
include:
  - template: Jobs/SAST.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Jobs/Secret-Detection.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Jobs/Dependency-Scanning.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Jobs/Container-Scanning.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: DAST.gitlab-ci.yml

variables:
  CS_IMAGE: $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA
  DAST_TARGET_URL: https://staging.example.com
  SAST_EXCLUDED_PATHS: "vendor, testdata"
```
MR'da: Security widget — yangi topilmalar (faqat shu MR keltirgan). Merge request approval policy: "CRITICAL topilma bo'lsa — security jamoasi approval'i kerak".

**Majburlash:** Security Policies -> Scan execution policy (har pipeline'da secret detection va SAST) yoki pipeline execution policy — loyiha `.gitlab-ci.yml` ga bog'liq emas.

**Triage jarayoni:**
1. Severity bo'yicha gate: CRITICAL/HIGH bloklaydi, qolganlari backlog.
2. False positive — "Dismiss" sabab bilan (audit qoladi).
3. Egasi va SLA: CRITICAL 7 kun, HIGH 30 kun.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Hamma topilmani bloklovchi qilish — jamoa shovqindan charchab, scan'ni o'chirish yo'lini qidiradi.
- Secret topildi va faqat commit'dan o'chirildi — u Git tarixida va kimdir allaqachon nusxalagan bo'lishi mumkin; avval **rotate** (bekor qilish), keyin tozalash.
- DAST'ni prod'ga qaratish — haqiqiy ma'lumotlarni o'zgartiradi; faqat staging.
- Ba'zi skanerlar faqat Ultimate'da to'liq (dashboard, policy) — Free/Premium'da natija faqat artifact.

**Senior nuqta:** Push protection (secret'ni push paytida rad etish) va pre-commit hook'lar — eng arzon himoya: secret repo'ga umuman tushmaydi. Skaner — signal; qiymat triage jarayonida.

33049.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `CI_DEBUG_TRACE: "true"` shell'ni `set -x` rejimida ishga tushiradi va runner ichki buyruqlarini ham logga chiqaradi — natijada barcha o'zgaruvchilar, shu jumladan masked va protected secret'lar, ochiq matnda job logiga yoziladi. Job logini loyihaga kirish huquqi bor har kim (public pipeline bo'lsa — hamma) o'qiy oladi. Shuning uchun uni faqat zarurat bo'lganda, nazorat ostida ishlat va keyin logni o'chir.

**Nima bo'ladi:**
```
CI_DEBUG_TRACE=true
  ++ export DEPLOY_TOKEN=glpat-AbC123...      <- masked emas!
  ++ export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
  ++ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer glpat-AbC123..."
log -> Developer'lar, ba'zan Guest/public ko'radi
```

**Xavfsizroq debug yo'llari:**
1. Aniq joyda, secret ishlatilmaydigan qismda `set -x` / `set +x`:
```yaml
script:
  - set -x
  - go build -v ./...
  - set +x
  - ./deploy.sh        # bu yerda secret bor - trace yo'q
```
2. Service konteyner loglari: `CI_DEBUG_SERVICES: "true"` (secret'larni emas, service loglarini ko'rsatadi).
3. Lokal reproduce:
```bash
docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/src -w /src golang:1.23 bash   # job image'ida qo'lda
gitlab-ci-local test                                          # .gitlab-ci.yml ni lokal ishlatish
```
4. Sintaksis: Pipeline editor -> Validate, yoki API `POST /projects/:id/ci/lint`.
5. Interaktiv: debug terminal (ba'zi executor'larda) — job'ga brauzerdan kirish.

**Agar baribir yoqish kerak bo'lsa:**
- Faqat bitta job'ga, `variables:` orqali (butun loyiha uchun emas).
- Maxfiy bo'lmagan test branch'ida, protected secret'lar yo'q joyda.
- Keyin job logini o'chirish (Erase job log) va ishlatilgan secret'larni rotatsiya qilish.
- GitLab'da debug logging'ni faqat Developer+ ko'ra oladi (yangi versiyalarda qo'shimcha cheklov) — lekin bu ham ko'p odam.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `CI_DEBUG_TRACE` ni loyiha CI/CD variable sifatida qo'yib unutish — har pipeline secret'larni sizdiradi.
- Public loyihada "Public pipelines" yoqiq — log'lar internetga ochiq.
- Log retention uzun — eski sizish oylab o'qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Debug ehtiyojining o'zi signal: murakkab mantiqni YAML'dan skriptga chiqar va uni lokal testlanadigan qil. Secret'larni umuman variable sifatida bermaslik (OIDC, Vault) bu xavfni tubdan kamaytiradi.

33050.a:
**Qisqa javob:** GitLab agent for Kubernetes (`agentk`) cluster ichida o'rnatiladi va GitLab'ga **chiquvchi** ulanish ochadi — cluster API'ni internetga ochish va kubeconfig'ni CI variable'da saqlash kerak bo'lmaydi. Ikki rejim: push (CI/CD workflow — pipeline agent orqali `kubectl`/`helm` bajaradi) va pull (GitOps — GitLab hozir Flux'ni tavsiya qiladi: cluster Git/OCI'dan holatni o'zi tortadi va drift'ni tuzatadi).

**Arxitektura:**
```
Push (CI access):
  pipeline job --(KUBECONFIG context agent orqali)--> KAS (GitLab) <== tunnel == agentk (cluster)
                                                           -> kubectl apply

Pull (GitOps, Flux):
  git push manifest -> Flux (cluster ichida) -> Git/OCI'dan tortadi -> apply
  agentk -> GitLab'ga holat va bildirishnomalar
```

**Amalda:**
Agent konfiguratsiyasi (`.gitlab/agents/prod-agent/config.yaml`):
```yaml
ci_access:
  projects:
    - id: acme/app
      access_as:
        ci_job: {}                 # impersonation: job identity bilan RBAC
      environments: ["production"]
```
Pipeline:
```yaml
deploy-prod:
  image: alpine/k8s:1.30.4
  environment: production
  script:
    - kubectl config use-context acme/platform:prod-agent
    - helm upgrade --install app ./chart --set image.digest=$IMAGE_DIGEST
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG
```
Agent o'rnatish: `helm install agentk gitlab/gitlab-agent --set config.token=$AGENT_TOKEN --set config.kasAddress=wss://kas.gitlab.example.com`.

**Push va pull:**

| | Push (CI) | Pull (Flux) |
|---|---|---|
| Soddalik | yuqori | o'rtacha |
| CI'da cluster huquqi | bor | yo'q |
| Drift tuzatish | yo'q | avtomatik |
| Audit | pipeline log | git log |
| Rollback | qayta deploy / environment rollback | `git revert` |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ci_access` ni butun guruhga va cluster-admin huquq bilan berish — har loyiha pipeline'i cluster'ni boshqaradi; impersonation va namespace RBAC bilan chekla.
- Eski "certificate-based cluster integration" — deprecated va o'chirilgan; agent'ga o'tish kerak.
- Push va pull'ni bitta resursga aralashtirish — Flux CI o'zgarishini qaytarib yuboradi.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod uchun pull (GitOps) — cluster faqat Git'dagi holatga ishonadi, CI esa faqat manifest/image versiyasini yangilaydi. Bu CI kompromatsiyasi bilan cluster kompromatsiyasi orasida chegara yaratadi.

33051.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pipeline execution policy (eski nomi compliance pipeline, u deprecated) — GitLab Ultimate'da markaziy jamoa (security/compliance) yozgan CI job'larini ko'p loyihaning pipeline'iga majburan qo'shish mexanizmi. Rejimlar: `inject_policy`/`inject_ci` (loyiha pipeline'iga job'larni qo'shadi) va `override_project_ci` (loyiha konfiguratsiyasini policy'niki bilan almashtiradi). Kerak bo'ladi: regulyatsiya (SOC 2, PCI DSS, bank) talabi bo'lsa — har deploy'dan oldin scan, audit, separation of duties isbotlanishi shart bo'lganda.

**Muammo:** `include: template: SAST` ni har loyiha `.gitlab-ci.yml` ga qo'yib chiqding. Developer bir qatorni o'chirsa — scan yo'q, auditor so'rasa isbot yo'q.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
security-policies loyiha (policy.yml)
   | guruhga biriktirilgan
   v
har loyiha pipeline'i = loyiha .gitlab-ci.yml + policy job'lari (majburiy)
   developer policy job'ini o'chira olmaydi
```

**Amalda (policy):**
```yaml
pipeline_execution_policy:
  - name: Majburiy xavfsizlik tekshiruvlari
    enabled: true
    pipeline_config_strategy: inject_policy
    content:
      include:
        - project: compliance/ci-policies
          ref: v1.3.0
          file: security-gates.yml
    policy_scope:
      compliance_frameworks:
        - id: 7          # "PCI" framework belgilangan loyihalar
```
Qo'shimcha nazoratlar:
- Separation of duties: MR approval rules — muallif o'z MR'ini tasdiqlay olmaydi; protected environment'da deploy tasdiqlovchi alohida guruh.
- Audit events: kim, qachon, qaysi commit'ni deploy qildi; eksport SIEM'ga.
- Compliance center: qaysi loyiha qaysi framework'da va qoidalarga mosmi.

**Trade-off:**

| Markaziy nazorat | Jamoa avtonomiyasi |
|---|---|
| isbotlanadigan compliance | moslashuvchanlik |
| bir xil standart | maxsus ehtiyojlar |
| policy xatosi hammaga ta'sir qiladi | xato lokal |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Policy'ni versiyasiz (`ref: main`) ulash — bitta xato yuzlab loyihaning pipeline'ini to'xtatadi; versiya va bosqichma-bosqich rollout (avval pilot loyihalar).
- `override` rejimini keng qo'llash — jamoalar o'z pipeline'ini boshqara olmaydi, norozilik va chetlab o'tish.
- Policy job'lari sekin — har pipeline'ga minutlar qo'shiladi; jamoalar shikoyat qiladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Faqat haqiqatan majburiy narsalarni (secret detection, SAST, imzolash, audit) policy qil; qolganini golden path shablonlari orqali taklif et. Policy ham kod: review, test, versiya, changelog.

33052.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Self-managed GitLab'ni masshtablash: yuk bo'yicha Reference Architecture tanlash (foydalanuvchi/RPS soniga qarab — bitta node'dan Gitaly Cluster, alohida PostgreSQL/Redis, Sidekiq node'larigacha yoki Cloud Native Hybrid), barcha fayllar (artifact, LFS, registry, uploads) object storage'da, runner'lar autoscaling va workload bo'yicha ajratilgan. Ishonchlilik: muntazam backup + `gitlab-secrets.json` alohida saqlash + tiklash mashqi, required stop'larga rioya qilgan holda upgrade, va monitoring (Prometheus, queue, Sidekiq backlog).

**Komponentlar:**
```
LB -> Rails (Puma) x N  -> PostgreSQL (Patroni, HA) + PgBouncer
                        -> Redis (Sentinel)
                        -> Gitaly / Gitaly Cluster (Praefect) - git repolar
   Sidekiq x N (fon ishlar)
   Object storage (S3): artifacts, LFS, registry, uploads, packages
Runners (alohida): k8s-build, prod-deploy, gpu - tags bilan
```

**Backup va DR:**
```bash
sudo gitlab-backup create STRATEGY=copy          # DB + repolar (+ ixtiyoriy)
sudo cp /etc/gitlab/gitlab-secrets.json /secure/  # ALOHIDA va shifrlangan!
sudo cp /etc/gitlab/gitlab.rb /secure/
```
`gitlab-secrets.json` siz tiklangan backup'da CI/CD variable'lar, runner token'lari, 2FA ma'lumotlari decrypt qilinmaydi. Object storage — o'z versioning/replikatsiyasi bilan alohida. Har chorak: staging'ga to'liq tiklash va vaqtni o'lchash (RTO).

**Upgrade:**
- Required upgrade stops (masalan 16.3 -> 16.7 -> 16.11 -> 17.x) — sakrab o'tib bo'lmaydi; `gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/blob/master/doc/update` dagi upgrade path tool.
- Background migration'lar tugashini kut (Admin -> Monitoring -> Background migrations).
- Avval staging, keyin prod; zero-downtime faqat multi-node'da.

**Runner tomoni:**
- Autoscaling (kubernetes / docker-autoscaler), bir nechta AZ.
- Ko'p runner GitLab API'ni poll qiladi — `check_interval` va runner soni muvozanati; Workhorse long polling yoqiq.
- Runner versiyasi GitLab versiyasiga mos (major.minor).

**Monitoring:**
```promql
sum(sidekiq_queue_size)                         # fon ish navbati
histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(gitlab_runner_job_queue_duration_seconds_bucket[10m]))
rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])   # Puma 5xx
```
Gitaly latency, PostgreSQL replikatsiya lag, disk bo'sh joyi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Artifact va registry lokal diskda — disk to'ladi, node yiqiladi.
- Backup bor, lekin hech qachon tiklanmagan — `gitlab-secrets.json` yo'qligi tiklashda aniqlanadi.
- Bir necha versiyani sakrab upgrade — migratsiya xatosi, DB buzilishi.
- Gitaly NFS ustida — qo'llab-quvvatlanmaydi va sekin.

**Senior nuqta:** Self-managed GitLab — kritik production servis (butun muhandislik to'xtaydi). Unga SLO, on-call va DR rejasi ber; ops yuki katta bo'lsa GitLab Dedicated/SaaS narxini halol solishtir.

33054.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Workspace — agent diskidagi job uchun ish papkasi: kod checkout qilinadi, build fayllari shu yerda paydo bo'ladi. Default holatda build'lar orasida **saqlanib qoladi**. Tozalash: `cleanWs()` (Workspace Cleanup plugin) `post { cleanup }` ichida, yoki `deleteDir()`, yoki ephemeral agent ishlatish.

**Muammo:** Oldingi build'dan qolgan fayllar keyingisini buzadi ("menda ishladi"), va yuzlab job'ning workspace'lari agent diskini to'ldiradi — build'lar "No space left on device" bilan yiqiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
/home/jenkins/workspace/
   api_main/          <- job workspace
   api_main@2/        <- bir vaqtda ikkinchi build
   api_main@tmp/      <- vaqtinchalik (secret fayllar, skriptlar)
   api_PR-42/
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
pipeline {
  agent any
  options { skipDefaultCheckout(false) }
  stages {
    stage('Build') { steps { sh 'make' } }
  }
  post {
    cleanup { cleanWs(deleteDirs: true, notFailBuild: true) }
  }
}
```
Agent'da diskni tekshirish:
```bash
du -sh /home/jenkins/workspace/* | sort -h | tail
df -h /home/jenkins
```
Manage Jenkins -> Nodes'da "Free Disk Space" monitor chegarasini sozla — disk kamaysa agent avtomatik offline bo'ladi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `cleanWs()` ni `steps` oxiriga qo'yish — build fail bo'lsa ishlamaydi; `post { cleanup }` kerak.
- Hamma narsani tozalash keshni ham o'chiradi (go mod cache, node_modules) — build sekinlashadi; keshni workspace'dan tashqarida saqla.
- `@tmp` papkalari ham to'planadi.

**Senior nuqta:** Eng toza yechim — har build uchun yangi K8s pod/konteyner agent: workspace pod bilan birga yo'qoladi, "snowflake" muammo yo'q. Tezlik uchun kesh alohida (PVC yoki remote cache) boshqariladi.

33056.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `junit` — test natijalarini (JUnit XML) o'qib, Jenkins'da test trendlari, yiqilgan testlar ro'yxatini ko'rsatadi va fail bo'lsa build'ni **UNSTABLE** qiladi. `archiveArtifacts` — build mahsulotlarini (binary, hisobot) Jenkins'da saqlab, keyin yuklab olishga imkon beradi; `fingerprint: true` — fayl qaysi build'dan chiqqanini kuzatadi.

**Muammo:** Test yiqilganda 5000 qatorli log'dan qaysi test ekanini qidirish — vaqt isrofi. Build qilingan binary'ni keyin topib bo'lmaydi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
test -> report.xml --junit--> Tests tab: 1240 passed, 3 failed (+trend grafigi)
build -> dist/app  --archiveArtifacts--> Build #57 -> Artifacts -> app (yuklab olish)
                     fingerprint (md5) -> "bu fayl #57 da yaratilgan, #60 da ishlatilgan"
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
stage('Test') {
  steps {
    sh 'gotestsum --junitfile reports/unit.xml -- ./...'
  }
}
...
post {
  always {
    junit allowEmptyResults: false, testResults: 'reports/*.xml'
    archiveArtifacts artifacts: 'dist/**', fingerprint: true, onlyIfSuccessful: true
  }
}
```
Go uchun XML: `gotestsum --junitfile` yoki `go test -v 2>&1 | go-junit-report > report.xml`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `junit` ni `steps` ichida test buyrug'idan keyin qo'yish — test fail bo'lsa unga yetib bormaydi; `post { always }` ishlat.
- Test buyrug'i fail bo'lganda build FAILURE, faqat `junit` ko'rsa UNSTABLE — farqni tushun.
- Katta artifact'lar (Docker image, GB'li fayllar) controller diskini to'ldiradi — Nexus/Artifactory/S3 ga yukla.
- `buildDiscarder` da `artifactNumToKeepStr` yo'q — eski artifact'lar abadiy.

**Senior nuqta:** Jenkins — artifact repository emas. Release artifact'lari versiyalangan va imzolangan holda tashqi registry'da bo'lsin; Jenkins'da faqat qisqa muddatli debug uchun.

33058.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **`lock`** (Lockable Resources plugin) — umumiy resursga (staging muhit, test qurilma) bir vaqtda faqat bitta build kirishini ta'minlaydi; boshqalari navbatda kutadi. **`milestone`** — build'lar tartibini kafolatlaydi: yangiroq build milestone'dan o'tsa, undan oldingi (eskiroq) build'lar shu milestone'ga yetganda **bekor qilinadi**.

**Muammo:** Ikki build bir vaqtda staging'ga deploy qilsa — muhit aralash holatga tushadi. Yoki #11 build #12 dan sekinroq yurib, #12 deploy qilgandan keyin eski kodni ustidan yozib qo'yadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
#11 ---- test (sekin) --------------- milestone(1) -> ABORT (#12 o'tib ketgan)
#12 ---- test --- milestone(1) -> lock(staging) -> deploy -> unlock
#13 ---- test ------- milestone(1) -> lock(staging) [kutadi] -> deploy
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
stage('Deploy staging') {
  steps {
    milestone(1)
    lock(resource: 'staging-env', inversePrecedence: true) {
      milestone(2)
      sh './deploy.sh staging'
      sh './smoke.sh staging'
    }
  }
}
```
`inversePrecedence: true` — lock bo'shaganda eng yangi build oladi. Resurslarni Manage Jenkins -> Lockable Resources'da (yoki JCasC'da) ta'riflash mumkin; `label` bilan pul (pool) ham qilinadi: `lock(label: 'test-device', quantity: 1)`.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `lock` ichida `input` — boshqalar soatlab kutadi; tasdiqni lock'dan tashqarida ol.
- `timeout` yo'q — osilgan build lock'ni abadiy ushlaydi.
- `disableConcurrentBuilds` faqat bitta job ichida; turli job'lar bitta muhitga deploy qilsa `lock` kerak.
- milestone'siz faqat lock — tartib kafolatlanmaydi (eski build keyinroq lock olishi mumkin).

**Senior nuqta:** Bu muammolar GitOps'da tabiiy hal bo'ladi: muhit holati Git'da, Argo CD faqat oxirgi commit'ni qo'llaydi. Jenkins'da qolsangiz, deploy job'lari uchun lock + milestone standart shablon bo'lsin.

33059.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Git server push/PR hodisasida Jenkins URL'iga HTTP POST (webhook) yuboradi, Jenkins tegishli job'ni ishga tushiradi va natijani **commit status / check** sifatida PR'ga qaytaradi. GitHub uchun eng yaxshi usul — **GitHub App** (GitHub Branch Source plugin), GitLab uchun — GitLab plugin + webhook secret token.

**Muammo:** Polling sekin va Git serverni yuklaydi. Dasturchi PR'da natijani ko'rishi va yiqilgan build merge'ni bloklashi kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
dev push -> GitHub --POST /github-webhook/ (HMAC imzo)--> Jenkins
                                                            | branch indexing
                                                            v
                                                   job PR-42 build
Jenkins --Checks API (GitHub App token)--> PR: "ci/jenkins: passed"
branch protection: required check -> merge tugmasi faqat yashilda
```

**Amalda (GitHub):**
1. GitHub'da App yarat: permissions — Checks (RW), Contents (R), Pull requests (R), Commit statuses (RW); webhook URL `https://ci.acme.uz/github-webhook/`, secret.
2. Jenkins'da credential: "GitHub App" turi (App ID + private key).
3. Multibranch/Organization Folder -> Branch Source: GitHub, shu credential.
4. Repo -> Settings -> Branches: `main` uchun required status check.

Tekshirish:
```bash
# GitHub: Settings -> Webhooks -> Recent Deliveries (javob kodi 200 bo'lishi kerak)
curl -I https://ci.acme.uz/github-webhook/
```
GitLab: Settings -> Webhooks -> URL `https://ci.acme.uz/project/<job>`, Secret token, "Push" va "Merge request events".

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Shaxsiy PAT ishlatish — odam ketsa CI to'xtaydi, rate limit kichik; GitHub App org darajasida va qisqa muddatli token.
- Webhook secret yo'q — har kim soxta POST bilan build ishga tushiradi.
- Jenkins ichki tarmoqda — webhook yetib bormaydi; relay (smee.io, webhook proxy) yoki polling.
- Reverse proxy `/github-webhook/` oxiridagi `/` ni yo'qotadi — 302/404.

**Senior nuqta:** Jenkins'ni internetga to'liq ochmasdan faqat webhook endpoint'ini (IP allowlist: GitHub meta API'dagi diapazonlar) ochish xavfsizroq.

33062.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **JCasC** (Configuration as Code plugin) — Jenkins tizim sozlamalarini (security, cloud'lar, credential'lar, tool'lar) YAML'da ta'riflaydi; Jenkins start'da shu YAML'ni qo'llaydi. **Job DSL** (seed job) — job'larni (Multibranch, folder) Groovy DSL bilan koddan yaratadi. Birgalikda: controller'ni nolinchi holatdan to'liq koddan qayta qurish.

**Muammo:** Jenkins yillar davomida UI orqali sozlangan — hech kim nima qayerda ekanini bilmaydi, server o'lsa tiklash haftalar. Har o'zgarish review'siz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Git repo (jenkins-config)
  plugins.txt      -> image build (jenkins-plugin-cli)
  casc/jenkins.yaml -> start'da qo'llanadi (CASC_JENKINS_CONFIG)
  jobs/seed.groovy -> seed job Job DSL bilan folder/job'larni yaratadi
         v
  Docker image -> K8s/VM -> ishlaydigan Jenkins (daqiqalarda)
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# casc/jenkins.yaml
jenkins:
  systemMessage: "Managed by JCasC - UI o'zgarishlari yo'qoladi"
  numExecutors: 0
  securityRealm:
    oic:
      clientId: jenkins
      clientSecret: "${OIDC_SECRET}"
      wellKnownOpenIDConfigurationUrl: "https://sso.acme.uz/.well-known/openid-configuration"
  clouds:
    - kubernetes:
        name: k8s
        namespace: ci
credentials:
  system:
    domainCredentials:
      - credentials:
          - string: { id: slack, scope: GLOBAL, secret: "${SLACK_TOKEN}" }
jobs:
  - script: >
      organizationFolder('acme') {
        organizations { github { repoOwner('acme'); credentialsId('gh-app') } }
      }
```
`${SLACK_TOKEN}` — env var, K8s Secret fayli yoki Vault'dan interpolatsiya. Joriy holatni eksport: Manage Jenkins -> Configuration as Code -> "View Configuration" (boshlang'ich nuqta sifatida).
```bash
curl -X POST -u admin:$TOKEN https://ci.acme.uz/configuration-as-code/reload
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Secret'larni YAML'ga ochiq yozish.
- UI'da qo'lda o'zgarish — keyingi reload'da yo'qoladi (drift); `systemMessage` bilan ogohlantir.
- Eksport qilingan YAML'ni tozalamasdan ishlatish — keraksiz default'lar to'la.
- Plugin versiyasi o'zgarsa JCasC sxemasi o'zgarishi mumkin — staging'da sina.

**Senior nuqta:** DR mashqi: har chorakda toza muhitda image + JCasC + seed'dan controller'ni ko'tar va vaqtni o'lcha. Build tarixi uchun alohida `JENKINS_HOME` backup kerak (JCasC uni saqlamaydi).

33063.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Bosqichli reja: **inventarizatsiya** (qaysi job'lar ishlatiladi, qaysilari o'lik), **plugin -> ekvivalent xaritasi**, logikani CI'dan mustaqil skriptlarga chiqarish, avtomatik konvertatsiya (`gh actions-importer`) boshlang'ich nuqta sifatida, **pilot** jamoalar, parallel ishlash davri, statik credential'lardan OIDC'ga o'tish, metrikalar bilan muvaffaqiyatni o'lchash va oxirida Jenkins'ni o'chirish.

**Muammo:** "Big bang" migratsiya — hamma pipeline bir hafta buziladi, release'lar to'xtaydi. 500 ta job'ning yarmi hech kimga kerak emas, lekin ko'chiriladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
1. Assess:   job'lar ro'yxati, oxirgi build sanasi, egasi, plugin'lar
2. Clean:    90+ kun ishlamagan job'larni o'chir
3. Decouple: logika -> Makefile/skript (CI faqat chaqiradi)
4. Map:      plugin -> action/component (yoki "yo'q" -> yechim)
5. Pilot:    2-3 jamoa, feedback, shablonlar (reusable workflow)
6. Wave:     jamoalar to'lqinlar bilan; ikkala CI parallel
7. Cutover:  required check yangi CI'ga; Jenkins read-only
8. Decom:    arxiv, o'chirish
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
gh extension install github/gh-actions-importer
gh actions-importer audit jenkins --output-dir audit/          # nimalar bor, qancha konvertatsiya bo'ladi
gh actions-importer dry-run jenkins --source-url https://ci.acme.uz/job/api --output-dir out/
gh actions-importer migrate jenkins --source-url ... --target-url https://github.com/acme/api
```
Audit hisobotida: qaysi qadamlar avtomatik o'tdi, qaysilari qo'lda ishlov talab qiladi.

**Xavflar va yechimlar:**
| Xavf | Yechim |
|---|---|
| on-prem hardware (HSM, Windows, GPU) | self-hosted runner |
| ichki tarmoqqa deploy | runner ichki tarmoqda yoki GitOps (pull) |
| statik credential'lar | OIDC -> cloud IAM rollari |
| Shared Library logikasi | reusable workflow / composite action |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Konvertor natijasini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri prod'ga — u "tarjima" qiladi, yaxshilamaydi.
- Eski Jenkins'ni o'chirmaslik — ikki tizim xarajati abadiy qoladi.
- Deploy tarixini yo'qotish — audit uchun log/artifact'larni arxivla.

**Senior nuqta:** Muvaffaqiyat metrikalari oldindan kelishilsin: pipeline vaqti, fail rate, lead time, ops soatlari. Migratsiya — CI'ni yaxshilash imkoniyati (kesh, OIDC, ephemeral runner), shunchaki ko'chirish emas.

33064.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ephemeral agent'larda kesh avtomatik saqlanmaydi, shuning uchun uni ataylab tashkil qilish kerak: (1) **pre-baked image** — kam o'zgaradigan dependency'lar image ichida; (2) **PVC** (K8s) — umumiy disk; (3) **proxy repo** (Nexus/Artifactory, Go proxy) — tarmoq orqali tez yuklash; (4) **remote build cache** (Bazel, Gradle, BuildKit registry cache) — eng yaxshi natija. PR build'lar keshga **yozmasligi** kerak.

**Muammo:** Har build yangi pod — `go mod download`, `npm ci`, Docker layer'lar har safar noldan: 2 daqiqalik build 12 daqiqaga aylanadi. Statik agent'da kesh bor edi, lekin "snowflake" muammosi bilan.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
             +---------------- kesh variantlari ----------------+
build pod -> | image ichida (deps)  : tez, lekin image eskiradi |
             | PVC /cache           : oddiy, RWX parallel xavfi |
             | proxy repo (Nexus)   : tarmoq, ishonchli manba   |
             | remote cache (S3/registry): hermetik, eng tez    |
             +--------------------------------------------------+
```

**Amalda:**
```groovy
// Go: PVC read-only + GOPROXY
agent { kubernetes { yaml '''
spec:
  containers:
  - name: go
    image: golang:1.23
    command: [sleep, infinity]
    env:
    - { name: GOPROXY, value: "https://nexus.acme.uz/repository/go-proxy/" }
    - { name: GOMODCACHE, value: /cache/gomod }
    volumeMounts: [{ name: cache, mountPath: /cache, readOnly: true }]
  volumes:
  - name: cache
    persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: go-cache, readOnly: true }
''' } }
```
```bash
# Docker image build: BuildKit registry cache
docker buildx build \
  --cache-from type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/acme/api:buildcache \
  --cache-to   type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/acme/api:buildcache,mode=max \
  -t ghcr.io/acme/api:$GIT_COMMIT --push .
```
Keshni yangilash: faqat `main` branch'dagi alohida job keshga yozadi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- RWX PVC'ga bir vaqtda ko'p build yozadi — kesh buziladi (corruption).
- PR build keshga yozadi — **cache poisoning**: zararli PR main build'ga ta'sir qiladi.
- Kesh kalitida lockfile hash yo'q — eski dependency'lar ishlatiladi.
- Kesh hajmi cheksiz o'sadi — TTL/tozalash yo'q.

**Senior nuqta:** Kesh — tezlik va hermetiklik/xavfsizlik orasidagi trade-off. Avval o'lcha (qaysi qadam vaqt yeydi), keyin eng arzon yechim: ko'pincha proxy repo + Docker layer cache 80% foydani beradi.

33065.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Jamoalarni **folder**'larga ajratish va **Role-based / Folder-based authorization** bilan har jamoaga faqat o'z folder'ida huquq berish; **credential'lar folder scope**'da; deploy agent'lariga kirishni cheklash (Job Restrictions, K8s pod template'lar, namespace); global trusted library faqat platforma jamoasida. Katta tashkilotda — bir nechta controller (har biznes bo'linmaga).

**Muammo:** Bitta Jenkins'da 20 jamoa: A jamoasining job'i B'ning prod credential'ini ishlata oladi, istalgan Jenkinsfile `label 'prod-deploy'` so'raydi, bitta jamoaning og'ir job'lari hammani sekinlashtiradi, bitta plugin upgrade hammani buzadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Controller
 +- folder team-a/   (role: team-a-devs -> Job/Build, Job/Read)
 |     credentials: team-a-prod (faqat shu folder ichida ko'rinadi)
 |     pod templates: ns ci-team-a, SA team-a-builder
 +- folder team-b/
 +- global: faqat platforma jamoasi (admin, trusted library, JCasC)
```

**Amalda (JCasC, Role Strategy plugin):**
```yaml
jenkins:
  authorizationStrategy:
    roleBased:
      roles:
        global:
          - name: authenticated
            permissions: [Overall/Read]
            entries: [{ group: authenticated }]
        items:
          - name: team-a
            pattern: "team-a/.*"
            permissions: [Job/Build, Job/Read, Job/Cancel, Job/Workspace]
            entries: [{ group: team-a }]
```
Credential folder'da: Folder -> Credentials -> "Stores scoped to team-a". Agent cheklash: K8s cloud'da har jamoaga alohida namespace va cheklangan ServiceAccount.

**Tuzoqlar:**
